title: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Verpleegkundige
description:
Als verpleegkundige sta je in voor verpleegkundige en verzorgende handelingen met als doel de levenskwaliteit en het comfort van de bewoner te bewaken, met oog voor de individuele noden. Dit houdt onder meer in dat u:

  • Participeert in de dagelijkse te verlenen hygiënische zorgen aan de bewoner: o.a. geven van toiletten, baden, knippen van nagels, haar- en baardverzorging, gebitsverzorging, mictietraining, ADL en PDL,…
  • Verpleegkundige zorgen toedient en vitale parameters observeert,
  • De zelfzorg begeleidt en bevordert,
  • De bewoner respectvol benadert als persoon, rekening houdend met de individuele noden en wensen. (kledij, juwelen, daginvulling,…),
  • Huishoudelijke taken opneemt waaronder bedden opmaken en verschonen, transporteren van vervuild linnen/incontinentiemateriaal, de dagelijkse opschik en in orde houden van de leefruimte van de bewoners
  • De voorbereiding van het maaltijdgebeuren doet en dat je voor de dagelijkse bedeling van dranken zorgt.
  • Je bent lid van een multidisciplinair team met als doel samen met andere disciplines te werken aan kwaliteitsvolle zorg.
  • Je rapporteert en staat in voor het uitvoeren van administratieve handelingen met als doel de algemene werking van de afdeling of de dienst te ondersteunen.
  • Je staat in voor de kwaliteitszorg met als doel het realiseren en bewaken van een kwalitatief hoogstaande en humane zorg- en dienstverlening.

Je bent een verpleegkundige die warme zorg combineert met professionaliteit. Met jouw kennis en empathie maak je elke dag het verschil voor onze bewoners. Je haalt energie uit samenwerken, verantwoordelijkheid opnemen en je blijft steeds oog hebben voor kwaliteit.

Jouw troeven

  • Je bent warm en persoonsgericht in je aanpak.
  • Je toont betrokkenheid en zet in op kwaliteit.
  • Je kan luisteren en met empathie inspelen op de noden van bewoners en collega’s.
  • Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid op en hebt zin om een rol als meter/peter op te nemen.
  • Je denkt creatief, stelt duidelijke doelen en onderbouwt je keuzes met een doordachte oordeelsvorming.
  • Je kan adviseren en helder presenteren, zowel naar collega’s als naar bewoners en hun familie.
  • Houder zijn van volgend diploma:

Verpleegkundige (bachelor): 

  • Ofwel een diploma van gegradueerd verple(e)g(st)er A1 of gerechtigd zijn de titel te voeren bij toepassing van artikel 25 van de KB van 17 augustus 1957, gewijzigd bij KB van 21 juli 1960, 27 oktober 1961 en 24 december 1966
  • Ofwel een bachelordiploma in de verpleegkunde
  • Ofwel een bachelor vroedkunde (diploma behaald voor 1/10/2018)

 Verpleegkundige (gegradueerd):

  • brevet van ziekenhuisverple(e)g(st)er of een diploma van verplegende van een hoger niveau.

Kennisvereisten

  • Elementaire kennis van de overkoepelende algemene regelgeving
  • Grondige kennis van de specifieke wetgeving in verband met de uitoefening van de functie en met de afdeling: woonzorgdecreet
  • Grondige kennis van verpleging- en verzorgingstechnieken en EHBO
  • Basiskennis van de software van de dienst
  • Basiskennis van de Zorgband Leie en Schelde en de werking van de welzijnsvereniging in zijn geheel

title: Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager
description:
Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.

As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.

The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.

To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager.

The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.


Jobomschrijving

As Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.

Infrastructure & Network Strategy

  • Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
  • Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
  • Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.



Service Ownership & Operations

  • Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
  • Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
  • Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.



Security & Risk Management

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
  • Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.



Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
  • Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
  • Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.



Leadership

  • Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.

Experience

  • Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
  • Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
  • Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.



Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
  • Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.



Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.



Languages skills

  • English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
  • French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.

About Corlutions

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.

Responsibilities

Project Implementation (80%)

  • Gain the trust of your customers
  • Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing)
  • Provide training
  • Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks

Internal improvement (20%)

  • Feedback to the internal team
  • Mentoring and training
  • Feedback for improvement

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).

What's great about the job?

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.

What we offer

  • Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings
  • Trainings — a real learning and development program
  • Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent
  • Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered!
  • Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have

  • Fluent in English and Dutch
  • Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis
  • Good communication and negotiation skills
  • Autonomous, assertive & proactive
  • Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools
  • Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude

Nice to Have

  • Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience
  • Fluent in French
  • Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus
  • Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

    • Experience with:
      • Azure and/or AWS
      • Enterprise application servers such as JBoss, WildFly, WebSphere or Oracle Middleware
      • Tomcat or similar runtimes
      • Application deployment, configuration, and runtime behaviour
    • Frontend awareness:
      • Familiarity with Angular and/or React
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with frontend teams
  • Integration & distributed systems:
    • Experience with API-driven integrations and messaging patterns
    • Understanding of distributed and event-driven architectures
  • AI & modern development practices:
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
    • Basic understanding of AI/ML services and API integrations.
    • Ability to assess AI-generated solutions from a quality, security and maintainability perspective.
  • Languages:
    • Fluent in English
    • Dutch and/or French

title: Verantwoordelijke Telecom & Verkoop
description:
Bij De Decker Expert in Londerzeel hebben we plannen om het telecomaanbod verder uit te bouwen en zijn we op zoek naar een nieuwe collega die zijn of haar schouders eronder wil zetten.

Iemand die klanten graag helpt bij de keuze van een nieuwe smartphone of abonnement maar die ook verder gaat dan alleen de verkoop. Want voor ons is service super belangrijk en stopt goede service niet zodra de klant aan de kassa is gepasseerd.

Gegevens overzetten naar een nieuwe smartphone, een toestel instellen, klanten verder helpen wanneer iets niet lukt, contacten met providers opvolgen… jij wordt het aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met telecom te maken heeft.

Maar dit is niet zomaar “een job” want je krijgt de kans om van die telecomafdeling echt jouw ding te maken.

Jij bouwt mee & wij geven je het vertrouwen

Wie is onze witte raaf?

We zoeken iemand die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en mee nadenkt hoe we onze telecomafdeling verder kunnen laten groeien? Welke acties kunnen we opzetten? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat klanten weten dat ze ook voor telecom bij De Decker terechtkunnen?

Je hebt niet alleen de natuurlijke commerciële flair maar volgt de verkoop en administratie mee op, onderhoudt de contacten met de providers en zorgt ervoor dat klanten ook na hun aankoop goed geholpen worden.

Een dag waarop alleen telecom passeert? Waarschijnlijk niet.

De Decker blijft natuurlijk een elektrowinkel dus je spring bij wanneer dat nodig is. Ben je uit de buurt dan ken je ons zéker en weet je dat we met een tof en kleinschalig team zijn. Van afwisseling gesproken – af en toe zal je ook bijspringen bij de levering.

Dat maakt de job net gevarieerd: het ene moment help je iemand zijn nieuwe smartphone volledig gebruiksklaar maken en het volgende moment sta je een klant in de winkel verder te helpen.

Wie zoeken we?

Een specifiek diploma vinden we minder belangrijk dan je ingesteldheid.

Je bent enthousiast, klantgericht en leergierig. Nieuwe smartphones, abonnementen en technologie schrikken je niet af – integendeel, je vindt het interessant om uit te zoeken hoe iets werkt.

Daarnaast:

  • neem je graag initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid;
  • kun je zelfstandig werken en zie je zelf wat er moet gebeuren;
  • heb je een commerciële ingesteldheid zonder klanten iets te willen aansmeren;
  • haal je voldoening uit een klant die écht geholpen buitenstapt;
  • spreek je zeer goed Nederlands;
  • kun je je ook goed uit de slag trekken in het Frans.

Heb je al ervaring in telecom, retail of verkoop? Dan is dat uiteraard mooi meegenomen. Maar minstens even belangrijk is dat je zin hebt om bij te leren en mee iets op te bouwen.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Voor onze klant te Nieuwkerke zoeken wij een Network Infrastructure Engineer.

Onze klant is een internationale speler binnen de voedingsindustrie, gespecialiseerd in diepgevroren aardappelproducten. De organisatie beschikt over verschillende productiesites en maakt deel uit van een internationale groep met een uitgebreide IT-infrastructuur.

Voor het internationale Network Engineering team zoeken we een ervaren netwerkspecialist die mee verantwoordelijk wordt voor het beheer, de beveiliging en verdere ontwikkeling van de wereldwijde netwerkinfrastructuur.

Je werkt met verschillende netwerk- en securitytechnologieën en ondersteunt zowel de klassieke IT-omgeving als de IT/OT-systemen binnen productie. Je overlegt regelmatig met internationale IT-collega's, externe partners en het Information Security team.

Wat ga je doen?
  • Je ontwerpt, implementeert en beheert bekabelde en draadloze bedrijfsnetwerken.
  • Je optimaliseert bestaande netwerkinfrastructuren binnen een internationale multivendoromgeving.
  • Je werkt aan netwerkarchitecturen voor datacenters, productieomgevingen, cloudtoegang en security.
  • Je configureert netwerkhardware en software volgens de geldende IT-architectuur en beveiligingsrichtlijnen.
  • Je analyseert en verhelpt complexe netwerkproblemen.
  • Je bewaakt de beschikbaarheid, stabiliteit en performantie van de netwerkomgeving.
  • Je monitort netwerkverkeer en detecteert storingen of afwijkingen.
  • Je registreert en volgt incidenten op via het centrale ticketsysteem.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met het Information Security team om netwerkoplossingen veilig te implementeren.
  • Je ondersteunt de uitrol van nieuwe netwerkdiensten en coördineert de nodige testen.
  • Je overlegt met externe IT-partners, leveranciers en managed service providers.
  • Je ondersteunt internationale IT-teams bij technische implementaties.
  • Je zorgt voor correcte netwerkdocumentatie en configuratiebeheer.
  • Je volgt nieuwe netwerk- en securitytechnologieën op en adviseert over mogelijke verbeteringen.
  • Je hebt een bacheloropleiding binnen IT, netwerktechnologie of een gelijkaardige richting, of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het beheren van complexe enterprise netwerkomgevingen.
  • Je beschikt over een sterke technische kennis van TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, VLAN, VPN, wireless networking, VOIP en MPLS.
  • Je hebt ervaring met netwerkhardware en securityoplossingen zoals Juniper, Aruba/HPE en Palo Alto firewalls.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met netwerkbeheerplatformen en tools zoals Juniper MIST AI, Aruba Central, AirWave, ClearPass, Apstra, Panorama en Wireshark.
  • Je hebt inzicht in IT Service Management (ITSM) en serveromgevingen zoals Microsoft en Linux.
  • Je hebt kennis van moderne netwerkbeveiliging, wireless security en authenticatieoplossingen.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met Hybrid Cloud networking en technologieën zoals SD-WAN, SASE, Azure en AWS.
  • Je kan complexe netwerkproblemen analyseren en gericht oplossen.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en houdt rekening met beveiliging, continuïteit en performantie.
  • Je communiceert vlot met technische collega's, leveranciers en externe partners.
  • Je werkt graag samen binnen internationale teams.
  • Je bent bereid om occasioneel naar andere regionale of internationale vestigingen te reizen.

title: Onthaalbediende (immo - vakantieverhuur)
description:
Voor een immokantoor in Oostduinkerke zoeken wij een commercieel bediende vakantieverhuur. Van gezellige strandhuisjes tot luxe appartementen met uitzicht op zee.

Wat ga je doen:

• Als commercieel medewerker verhuur ben je de held(in) die potentiële huurders met open armen ontvangt (figuurlijk dan, hè!).

• Je bent een ster in het verkopen van dromen - je vertelt vol passie over de accommodaties, de omgeving en alle leuke dingen die Oostduinkerke te bieden heeft.

• Geen boeking is jou te veel! Je regelt reserveringen, beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail of social media, en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt.

• Je zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het volledige proces van de verhuur, waarbij je alles nauwgezet zal opvolgen en je schouders zet onder het project van opstart tot het opstellen van de reservatie.

• Ook na de boeking sta je paraat. Je controleert de schoonmaak (indien nodig verzorg jij de finishing touch) en zorgt ervoor dat de gasten zich welkom voelen vanaf het moment dat ze binnenkomen.

 

Praktische zaken neem jij er met plezier bij.

  • Iemand met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en een sprankelende persoonlijkheid. Jij bent het zonnetje in huis!
  • Werken op zaterdag lukt je perfect! 
  • Je bent een kei in multitasken en houdt het hoofd koel, zelfs als het druk is.
  • Ervaring in de toerisme-, horeca- of verhuurbranche is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Als je maar barst van de motivatie!
  • Kennis van zowel Frans, Duits en noties Engels = zeer belangrijk!

title: Flexijob Housekeeping (kamermeisje/kamerjongen) VelotelBrugge****
description:
Je staat mee in voor de schoonmaak, de orde en het onderhoud van kamers, badkamers en gemeenschappelijke ruimtes. Je werkt volgens de kwaliteitsvereisten van de organisatie en de hygiënische en veiligheidsnormen. Bijkomende activiteiten kunnen zijn: het schoonmaken en het onderhoud van linnen

Wie zoeken wij? Een toffe collega die ons jong team wil komen versterken! Iemand die van aanpakken weet en ons misschien zelfs aangenaam verrast! Met veel enthousiasme en professionaliteit zorg jij, met het volledige team, voor een geweldig verblijf van onze gasten. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Enthousiasme, professionaliteit, een hands-on mentaliteit en motivatie om bij te leren des te meer! Dankzij jouw scherpe blik en je warme ontvangst kan de gast niet anders: hij moét wel terugkomen!

title: Flexi-job broodjes Broodje Velootje | Hotel Velotel Brugge****
description:
Ben je op zoek naar een leuke flexi job en wil je terecht komen in een hecht team dat aanvoelt als familie? Kom dan zeker eens bij ons langs!

Wij zoeken een medewerker voor enkele voomiddagen in de week om achter de schermen te helpen in onze gloednieuwe broodjeszaak Broodje Velootje. Samen met jou kijken welke dagen het beste voor je passen!

title: Klinisch psycholoog volwassenen
description:
Voor de uitbreiding van ons volwassenenaanbod zoekt groepspraktijk Op Dreef een klinisch psycholoog die graag werkt vanuit een warme, betrokken en persoonsgerichte aanpak.

Je begeleidt volwassenen met uiteenlopende psychologische hulpvragen, zoals stress, angst, somberheid, een laag zelfbeeld, perfectionisme, emotionele moeilijkheden of ingrijpende levensgebeurtenissen. Samen met de cliënt verken je wat er speelt en werk je aan inzicht, veerkracht en verandering, met aandacht voor diens behoeften, mogelijkheden en tempo.

Jouw taken

  • Je voert intakegesprekken en brengt de hulpvraag en het functioneren van de cliënt in kaart.

  • Je stelt samen met de cliënt passende begeleidingsdoelen op.

  • Je biedt individuele psychologische begeleiding vanuit wetenschappelijk onderbouwde methodieken en jouw expertise.

  • Je volgt het verloop van de begeleiding op en stuurt bij waar nodig.

  • Je zorgt voor een zorgvuldige dossiervoering.

  • Je overlegt met collega’s en stemt, waar relevant en met toestemming van de cliënt, af met andere

  • Je draagt vanuit jouw interesses en specialisaties bij aan de verdere uitbouw van het volwassenenaanbod binnen Op Dreef.

Je werkt zelfstandig binnen onze groepspraktijk, met ruimte voor een eigen professionele invulling en verbinding met collega’s.

Algemene vereisten

  • Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in de klinische psychologie

  • Je bent ingeschreven bij de Psychologencommissie

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de begeleiding van volwassenen. Relevante ervaring of een aanvullende therapieopleiding is een meerwaarde.

  • Je werkt warm, betrokken en respectvol, met aandacht voor de eigenheid en context van elke cliënt.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en zorgvuldig, en staat open voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

  • Je handelt volgens de deontologische richtlijnen en gaat vertrouwelijk om met cliëntgegevens.

  • Je bent bereid om op zelfstandige basis samen te werken en beschikt bij de start over de nodige verzekering voor beroepsaansprakelijkheid.

title: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

  • A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
  • An international and multilingual setting
  • An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
  • A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security


Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

  • Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
  • Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
  • Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
  • Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
  • Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)

Access and security

  • Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
  • Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)

Hardware and lifecycle

  • Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
  • Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
  • Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
  • Tickets, escalation and coordination
  • Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
  • Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
  • Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
  • Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
  • Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)

You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
  • At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
  • Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
  • Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
  • Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity

Assets

  • Knowledge of Arabic
  • Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
  • Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
  • IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)

Soft skills

  • Customer focus and service mindset
  • Autonomy and rigour in incident management
  • Clear communication with non-technical users
  • Hands-on, proactive attitude

title: Lab Support Operator
description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.


Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
  • Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
  • Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
  • Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
  • Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.

Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

  • You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
  • Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
  • You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
  • Your attention to detail is unmatched.
  • Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

title: Bus Mechanic
description:
Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.


Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
  • Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
  • Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.
  • Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

title: Driver C/CE
description:
Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.


Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
  • Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
  • Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.
  • Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.
  • Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:

  • Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
  • Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.
  • Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.
  • Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.
  • Able to provide good references.

title: Mold Technician
description:
Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 


Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.
  • Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.
  • Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.
  • Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.
  • Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.
  • Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.
  • Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.
  • Basic knowledge of electricity.
  • Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.
  • Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

title: Industrial Electrician
description:
About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.


Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:

  • Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.
  • Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.
  • Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.
  • Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.
  • Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.
  • Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
description:
Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal


Jobomschrijving

title: Captain for Tugboat

title: Production Operator (with housing)
description:
Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people.

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.


Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization.

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:

  • Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.
  • Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.
  • Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.
  • Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.
  • Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.
  • Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:

  • Experience in a production environment.
  • Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.
  • Ability to work with a computer.
  • Good command of English or Dutch.
  • Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.
  • Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.
  • No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).
  • Physical work does not deter you.
  • Basic technical knowledge.

title: Maintenance Technician (Junior) – Full Training Provided
description:

The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:

  • Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).

title: Dispatch and Labelling Operator
description:
Job Description


As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

  • Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.
  • Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.
  • Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.
  • Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.
  • Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.
  • Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

  • You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!
  • You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.
  • You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.
  • You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.
  • You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!
  • You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.
  • As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)
  • You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Spremač/ica“.

title: MONTER/KA III (821206) U ODJELU STROJARSKOG ODRŽAVANJA
description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – strojarskog ili metalskog smjera • 2 godine radnog iskustva • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• sudjeluje u svim monterskim radovima na terenu i u radionici; izmjeni crpnih agregata, izmjeni zaporno - regulacijske armature (zasuni, hidrostopovi, leptirice ručne i elektro-mot.), rekonstrukcije cijelih strojarnica, komora, objekata, generalnih popravaka crpnih agregata, kompresora i ostalih strojeva, utovar i istovar crpnih agregata i ostale opreme uz pomoć dizalice na kamion • sudjeluje u izmjeni, montaži i demontaži svih vrsta cijevnih instalacija, ventila, uređaja i opreme vezane uz objekte crpljenja • vrši izradu raznih konstrukcija, pomoćnih naprava, bravarskih radova na izradi fazonskih komada, upora i sl. • samostalno izvodi popravke i remonte crpnih agregata i ostalih pomoćnih uređaja manjih kapaciteta i gabarita • po potrebi, sudjeluje u radovima na održavanju hidroforskih postrojenja • obavezan je odazvati se na poziv dispečera poradi intervencije i izvan radnog vremena

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja)

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

https://mrosp.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama-16/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-12153/rad-i-zaposljavanje/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-i-zaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom/5946

Vodoopskrba i odvodnja d.o.o. zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu te ne prihvatiti ni jednu dostavljenu ponudu.

title: MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA
description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA-MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

title: TEHNIČAR/KA ZA PRIPREMU SMJENE
description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI d.d. dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedna od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka za pripremu smjene Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zaduženje za održavanje strojeva linije obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće.
  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.

title: STROJAR U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS strojarskog smjera

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 1 smjena - prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.335,14 € do 1.535,40 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u
  • procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda i crpnim stanicama,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i
  • zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja
  • otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme, remont opreme, servisi opreme,
  • zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zapornica i opreme koja se koristi u pročišćavanju otpadnih
  • voda ,
  • održavanje strojarske opreme i crpki (kontrola nastanka korozije, zaštita adekvatnim
  • premazima),
  • rukovanje i upravljanje strojo opremom, podmazivanje i kontrola nivoa ulja,
  • praćenje intervala za redovite servise opreme,
  • briga oko pravovremene nabavke rezervnih dijelova,
  • održavanje opreme u službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda (pranje, čišćenje),
  • rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama,
  • nadopuna kemikalija u odgovarajuće spremnike prema radnim postupcima,,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti slijedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar (pisarnica) ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

Rok za predaju prijava je 11.10.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično, bez navođenja razloga.

title: KONGRESNI TEHNIČAR/KONGRESNA TEHNIČARKA
description:
OPIS POSLOVA:

  • priprema dvorana i opreme potrebne za odvijanje događanja a sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • samostalno postavljanje opreme i ostvarivanje video programa te manjih ozvučenja, snimanja i reprodukcija u suradnji s vanjskim organizatorom i zaposlenicima Društva na terminima postave, pokusa i programa
  • samostalno postavljanje scenske i ambijentalne rasvjete sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • obavljanje svih tonskih snimanja za potrebe Društva i korisnika
  • prikupljanje i reproduciranje audio, video i svjetlosnog sadržaja sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • osnovno održavanje, popravak i čišćenje postojeće i nove tonske i video opreme
  • rad na remontu postojeće cjelokupne instalacije slabe struje, kao i redovna briga o održavanju tonske, video i ostale elektroničke opreme u vlasništvu Društva
  • za vrijeme održavanja programa, rad u propisanoj odjeći
  • izvršavanje aktivnosti i radnji potrebnih za obavljanje prethodno opisanih poslova radnog mjesta
  • odgovoran je za povjerena sredstva i predmete rada te za uredno, pravodobno i točno izvršavanje radnih zadataka prema pravilima struke
  • obavlja druge poslove i izvanredne radne zadatke po nalogu Voditelja IT odjela i Uprave u okviru svoje stručne spreme i stečenog znanja
  • Obvezno provodi mjere zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara, zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti objekata,
  • Dosljedno provodi sve procedure i propise,
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog

Tražimo osobu koja je pedantna i odgovorna u svom radu, koja ima izraženu sklonost samostalnom obavljanju zadataka, ali dobro funkcionira i u timskoj organizaciji poslova.

Istovremeno nudimo rad u dinamičnom i lijepom okruženju, te razne mogućnosti usavršavanja i stalnog educiranja.

Također, ističemo da društvo Olympia Vodice u svojstvu poslodavca aktivno se zalaže za jednake mogućnosti i jednako postupanje prema svim svojim zaposlenicima, bez obzira na rasu, boju kože, spol, jezik, dob, nacionalnost, seksualnu orijentaciju i identitet, invaliditet, vjeru, političko ili drugo uvjerenje, imovinu, rođenje ili bilo koji drugi status. Svjesni smo naše uloge velike organizacije te odgovornosti utjecaja na živote svih naših zaposlenika, korisnika naših usluga i društva u cjelini. Svim budućim zaposlenicima poručujemo da svoju društvenu odgovornost shvaćamo ozbiljno, uz poduzimanje mjera za borbu protiv bilo kojeg oblika diskriminacije, zlostavljanja i seksualnog uznemiravanja.

title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.
Prijave se šalju na: info@proning-dhi.hr PRONING DHI d.o.o. Otona Kučere 5, 10000 Zagreb www.proning-dhi.hr

title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
description:
PROJEKTANT (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

title: VODITELJ/ICA PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA - AREA MANAGER
description:
ZIEGLER je proizvođač vatrogasnih vozila i opreme s tradicijom duljom od 130 godina. ZIEGLER Grupa zapošljava više od 1.200 djelatnika diljem svijeta, posluje na 9 proizvodnih lokacija te godišnje proizvede više od 900 vozila. Dio je velike globalne grupacije CIMC, vodećeg svjetskog dobavljača logističke i energetske opreme. ZIEGLER d.o.o. posluje u Hrvatskoj od 2000. godine te djeluje na dvije proizvodne lokacije – u Zagrebu i Kutini. Zbog razvoja našeg tima i daljnjeg širenja prisutnosti na tržištu tražimo: VODITELJA/ICU PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA – 1 izvršitelj – Mjesto rada: Zagreb ili Kutina Idealan kandidat:

  • VŠS ili VSS ekonomskog, poslovnog, tehničkog ili srodnog usmjerenja
  • Najmanje 1 godina iskustva u prodaji, razvoju poslovanja ili upravljanju ključnim kupcima
  • Izražene komunikacijske, pregovaračke i interpersonalne vještine
  • Dokazan pristup usmjeren na kupca, uz fokus na ostvarivanje prodajnih ciljeva i poslovnih rezultata
  • Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno B2 razina)
  • Organizirana, proaktivna i rezultatski usmjerena osoba
  • Spremnost na putovanja unutar dodijeljene regije
  • Interes za automobilsku i vatrogasnu industriju
Prednost imaju kandidati koji imaju:
  • Iskustvo u prodaji u automobilskoj, vatrogasnoj ili srodnoj industriji
  • Poznavanje postupaka javne nabave i natječajne dokumentacije
  • Iskustvo rada u ERP sustavima
  • Poznavanje dodatnih regionalnih jezika
Opis poslova:
  • Razvijanje i održavanje poslovnih odnosa s postojećim i potencijalnim kupcima na dodijeljenom području
  • Prepoznavanje novih poslovnih prilika i aktivno širenje tržišne prisutnosti tvrtke
  • Upravljanje cjelokupnim prodajnim procesom – od prvog kontakta s kupcem do sklapanja ugovora
  • Izrada komercijalnih ponuda, ponuda za natječaje i druge dokumentacije u suradnji s internim odjelima
  • Sudjelovanje u postupcima javne nabave te koordinacija pripreme natječajnih ponuda
  • Posjeti kupcima, održavanje prezentacija, demonstracija proizvoda i vođenje pregovora
  • Praćenje tržišnih trendova, aktivnosti konkurencije i potreba kupaca te redovito izvještavanje uprave
  • Ostvarivanje dogovorenih prodajnih ciljeva i doprinos rastu poslovanja tvrtke
  • Izrada prodajnih izvještaja, prognoza i ostale povezane dokumentacije
  • Predstavljanje tvrtke na stručnim događanjima, sajmovima i konferencijama
Nudimo:
  • Rad u dinamičnom međunarodnom okruženju
  • Priliku za rad u rastućoj industriji
  • Profesionalni razvoj uz podršku iskusnog tima
  • Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zaposlenja na neodređeno vrijeme

Ako ste zainteresirani za ovu poziciju, pošaljite svoj životopis i motivacijsko pismo na e-mail posao@ziegler.hr ili ih dostavite osobno u Odjel ljudskih resursa najkasnije do 22.10.2026. ZIEGLER is a manufacturer of firefighting vehicles and equipment with a tradition of over 130 years. The ZIEGLER Group employs more than 1,200 people worldwide, operates at 9 production locations, and produces over 900 vehicles annually. It is part of the large global CIMC group, a leading world supplier of logistics and energy equipment. ZIEGLER d.o.o. has been operating in Croatia since 2000, with two production locations – in Zagreb and Kutina. Due to the growth of our team and further expansion of our market presence, we are looking for: AREA MANAGER - 1 position - Work location: Zagreb or Kutina

Ideal candidate:

  • University or higher vocational degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (VŠS/VSS)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, or account management
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proven customer-oriented approach with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken (minimum B2 level)
  • Highly organized, proactive, and results-driven
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region
  • Strong interest in the automotive and firefighting industries

Advantage:

  • Experience in Sales in the automotive, firefighting or related industry
  • Knowledge of public procurement and tender procedures
  • Experience working with ERP systems
  • Knowledge of additional regional languages

Job description:

  • Developing and maintaining business relationships with existing and potential customers within the assigned territory
  • Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding the company's market presence
  • Managing the complete sales process, from initial customer contact to contract signing
  • Preparing commercial offers, quotations, and tender documentation in cooperation with internal departments
  • Participating in public procurement procedures and coordinating the preparation of bids
  • Conducting customer visits, presentations, product demonstrations, and negotiations
  • Monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, and providing regular feedback to management
  • Achieving agreed sales targets and contributing to the company's growth objectives
  • Preparing sales reports, forecasts, and other related documentation
  • Representing the company at industry events, trade fairs, and professional conferences

We offer:

  • Work in dynamic international environment
  • Opportunity to work in a growing industry
  • Professional development within an experienced team
  • Fixed-term employment contract with possibility to extend to permanent duration

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV and Cover letter via e-mail to posao@ziegler.hr or submit to HR in person until 22.10.2026.
