title: Director, Sales Operations DACH (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

- Supporting portfolio and investment decisions with architectural impact assessments, transparency and pragmatic recommendations.
- Coaching business and IT stakeholders in top-down architecture planning and helping translate strategic objectives into clear architectural priorities and roadmaps.
- Contributing to the further development of architecture governance, principles, standards and guardrails to enable consistent and value-driven architecture decisions across central and local domains.
- Moderating architecture discussions and helping stakeholders find viable solutions that balance business needs, technological options and economic considerations.
- Building strong partnerships with business functions, IT teams, domain experts and architects across the organization.
- Advising business and IT teams on architectural best practices while ensuring alignment with defined Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines.

- role with real impact: you will help shape strategic domains and contribute to the future direction of Enterprise Architecture within an international group.
- A broad variety of exciting topics across business and IT, with the opportunity to work across organizational boundaries.
- The chance to create transparency, simplify complexity and enable better decisions in a dynamic transformation environment.
- A collaborative team culture where ownership, curiosity and pragmatic thinking are highly valued.
- The opportunity to act as a trusted advisor and enabler for business and IT stakeholders.

Your profile:

- Good understanding of current technological trends, innovations and state-of-the-art solutions, as well as their relevance for business transformation.
- Experience in facilitating architecture decisions and aligning different stakeholder perspectives across business, IT and architecture.
- A hands-on architecture driven mindset and the motivation to actively support architecture concepts from early idea to practical implementation together with business and IT teams.
- Strong communication, moderation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural topics clearly and convincingly to different audiences.

- You enjoy working independently, taking ownership and contributing as a motivated team player who wants to make a visible difference.

Then we look forward to meeting you. Join us and help shape architecture that creates transparency, enables better decisions and supports the future development of the Heraeus Group.

title: Persönliche Assistenz (m/w/d) - Recklinghausen (Betreuungskraft / Alltagsbegleiter/in)
description:
Hier suchen wir speziell Assistenz- und Pflegekräfte für eine Rollstuhlfahrerin in Recklinghausen. Auch Quereinsteiger möglich, gern mit Führerschein.

Wir sind kein klassischer Pflegedienst, wir sind ein Lebensmodell. Bei uns werden schwerbehinderte Menschen in einer 1:1-Situation bis zu 24 Stunden täglich versorgt. So ermöglichen wir unseren Kundinnen und Kunden ein selbstbestimmtes Leben und die soziale Teilhabe. Und da fehlst nur noch Du!

Wir suchen engagierte Menschen, die mit uns diesen gemeinsamen Weg gehen, den unser Verein seit 1982 mit mittlerweile über 250 Mitarbeitenden täglich lebt. Was musst Du mitbringen? Soziales Engagement, Empathie, physische und psychische Belastbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit sowie den unbedingten Willen, sich für das selbstbestimmte Leben einzusetzen. Du brauchst keine Ausbildung, wir beschäftigen Menschen, keine Zertifikate. Also sind auch Quereinsteiger willkommen. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sind anleitungskompetent und wissen, was sie brauchen. Zudem gibt es eine kollegiale Einarbeitung, eine Unterstützung durch die Pflegediensleitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen.

Deine Aufgaben sind die Alltagsbegleitung und die Pflege. Wir arbeiten je nach Bedarf in verschiedenen Schichtmodellen, so dass wir auch auf Seiten der Mitarbeitenden verschiedene Lebensmodelle unterstützen können. Dabei bezahlen wir in Anlehnung an den Tarif nach TVÖD. Somit können wir auch ungelernten Kräften einen vergleichsweise wirklich guten Lohn zahlen.

Kurzum: Bei uns stehen die Menschen im Vordergrund bei einer Pflege ohne Stoppuhr. Wir brauchen Dich und Deine Haltung!

title: Alltagsassistenz (w/m/d) Pflege & Teilhabe im Arbeitgebermodell (Fachkraft - Pflegeassistenz)

- empathisch, geduldig und herzlich
- motivierend und positiv im Umgang mit Menschen
- lernbereit und offen für neue Aufgaben
- selbstständig und eigeninitiativ
- sorgfältig und strukturiert in Deiner Arbeitsweise
- diskret und vertrauenswürdig
- humorvoll und menschlich zugewandt

title: Chefkoch/Chefköchin (m/w/d) - Haus Rahenkamp (Koch/Köchin)
description:
Bei uns darfst du deinen Senf dazugeben.

Im Haus Rahenkamp entsteht gerade etwas Neues: Ein traditionsreicher Ort bekommt ein neues Konzept, eine neue Küche und vor allem neue Ideen. Dafür suchen wir einen Koch/ eine Köchin (m/w/d), der/die Lust hat, von Anfang an mit dabei zu sein und nicht einfach nur nach vorgegebenen Rezepten zu kochen.

Deine Aufgabe

Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Team dafür, dass unsere Gäste gerne wiederkommen – und zwar nicht nur wegen der Location.

Du bist verantwortlich für die Zubereitung unserer Speisen, achtest auf Qualität und Hygiene und bringst deine eigenen Ideen mit ein. Dabei möchten wir gemeinsam eine Küche entwickeln, die modern, unkompliziert und trotzdem bodenständig ist.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung unserer Speisen
- Sicherstellung einer gleichbleibend hohen Qualität
- Mitgestaltung unserer Speisekarte
- Entwicklung neuer Gerichte und saisonaler Angebote
- Warenannahme, Lagerung und Kontrolle von Lebensmitteln
- Einhaltung der Hygiene- und HACCP-Vorgaben
- Organisation und Sauberkeit deines Arbeitsplatzes
- Zusammenarbeit mit Service und dem gesamten Team
- Unterstützung bei Veranstaltungen, Feiern und besonderen Events

Das bringst du mit

Du musst bei uns nicht perfekt in ein vorgegebenes Raster passen. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Bock auf deinen Beruf und Lust auf etwas Neues hast.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Koch/Köchin oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung
- Freude am Kochen und am Umgang mit Lebensmitteln
- Kreativität und Interesse daran, eigene Ideen einzubringen
- selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Qualitätsbewusstsein
- Teamgeist und Zuverlässigkeit
- Bereitschaft, auch an Wochenenden und bei Veranstaltungen zu arbeiten

Du bist Quereinsteiger und hast richtig Erfahrung in der Küche?

Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert nicht nur, was auf deinem Papier steht, sondern vor allem, was du kannst.

Was wir dir bieten

Bei uns bekommst du nicht einfach einen Platz an einer bestehenden Küchenzeile – du bekommst die Chance, eine neue Küche mit aufzubauen.

- Mitgestaltung von Anfang an: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.
- Kreativer Spielraum: Gemeinsam entwickeln wir unser gastronomisches Konzept.
- Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Hierarchien – gute Ideen dürfen schnell umgesetzt werden.
- Abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsplatz: Restaurant, Veranstaltungen, Feiern und besondere Events sorgen dafür, dass kein Tag wie der andere ist.
- Motiviertes Team: Wir wollen gemeinsam etwas aufbauen und dabei auch Spaß an der Arbeit haben.
- Faire und verlässliche Arbeitsbedingungen

Und das Wichtigste:

Wir wollen keine Küche, in der jeder nur seinen Dienst nach Plan macht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der sagt:
„Lass uns das ausprobieren.“

Wenn du Lust hast, deine Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns das neue Haus Rahenkamp kulinarisch auf die Beine zu stellen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Security Industry Specialist (Chief-Information-Security-Officer)
employer: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
description:
The Amazon Security, Special Programs Evaluations Assessments & Response (SPEAR) Team is seeking an experienced and talented Physical Security Evaluator to join the SPEAR Evaluations Europe, Middle East & Africa Team (EMEA). This position is responsible for performing physical security evaluations of our facilities in the EMEA region.

You will join a cadre of experienced and skilled specialists responsible for evaluating the application of physical security, including people, processes and technology. You will identify and document vulnerabilities, provide guidance on the path to resolution, and are responsible for all written reports related to the evaluations you conduct. You will participate in the development, analysis, and implementation of physical security standards and identify areas for improvement.

As a SPEAR Evaluator, you will partner and work directly with other AWS/Amazon Physical Security Teams, AWS/Amazon Management, and customers to aid in the real-world application of physical security to existing and new facilities. You will also review new technology and security measures for possible application to the existing suite of security processes and measures to enhance the security posture of our facilities.

You must be able to work at all levels from the theoretical knowledge of physical security protection systems and principles to the practical application and real-world implementation of processes and measures. The Physical Security Specialist must execute detailed evaluations of our existing facilities, identifying areas which can be improved to enhance the physical security posture of each site.

Evaluations are conducted in person on AWS/Amazon properties around the globe and require you to travel up to 50% of the time. You will work in environments where you may be exposed to loud noises, cold, heat, adverse weather, and elevated structures. You must be able to climb ladders and work with diagnostic tools, and utilize hand tools to inspect equipment at elevated heights. You will conduct inspections of extensive opens spaces and fence lines that include walking significant distances, both during day and nighttime hours, and stand for significant periods of time. You must be able to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including hearing protection, eye protection, impact resistant head protection, safety footwear, high visibility clothing, cut resistant gloves, and other PPE as required by local ordinance or regulation.

Key job responsibilities

- Organize and lead the execution of evaluations of facilities within the EMEA Region. Ensure all issues identified as part of this evaluation process are documented and all evaluation related documentation is completed within the required parameters.
- Partner directly with AWS/Amazon Security partners to review security related documentation and help them understand the implementation of all physical security standards and policies to their real-world environment.
- Develop and review new technology and security measures for possible application to the existing suite of security processes and measures to enhance the security posture of our facilities.
- Assist the global SPEAR Team to determine the strategic direction of the Physical Security Program based on customer interaction and demonstrative outputs.
- Keep the leadership team fully informed of stakeholder and customer engagement status, issues, and activities.
- Maintain knowledge of industry trends and events. Develop and maintain connections with key industry personnel and manufacturers.

About the team
Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working on physical security design and implementation of Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems
- Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
- Experience conducting physical security assessments, inspections, evaluations of people, processes and/or measures including access control/intrusion detection and video surveillance systems.
- Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED) experience.
- Travel up to 50% of your working time across the region and globally.
- Ability to successfully perform key job functions in a physically demanding work environment.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in physical security best practices including application of physical security systems, investigation techniques, management of contract security guards and incident management
- Knowledge of cloud computing concepts
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
- Applicable physical security industry specific qualifications, certifications, and/or education.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.

title: Director, Sales Operations DACH (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

title: Office Manager & Team Assistance (m/f/d) (Office-Manager/in)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

At TYTAN, every mission starts with a first impression, and that's where you come in. As our Office Manager and Team Assistant you are the face and the heartbeat of our Berlin representation. You'll be the first point of contact for guests and partners. You will shape the daily rhythm of the office, create a welcoming environment for our international team, and ensure that everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, including day-to-day support for the team and leadership.
As a young, fast-growing scale-up, we need someone who's comfortable wearing many hats and moving fluidly between office management, team support, and personal assistance to our team lead, depending on what the day brings.

Your roadmap to make an impact:

- Be the ambassador of TYTAN: warmly welcome visitors, partners, and new hires, ensuring they feel the unique spirit of our company from the moment they arrive.
- Keep operations flowing: oversee office organization, supplies, vendor coordination, and facility management to ensure a smooth daily workflow.
- Support leadership and teams: assist with scheduling, travel arrangements, and meeting coordination.
- Provide personal assistance to the team lead and keep the team running: manage calendars, coordinate travel, prepare meetings, and handle recurring personal and organizational matters with discretion.
- Create a vibrant workplace culture: organize events, foster a positive office atmosphere, and help maintain a space where collaboration thrives.
- Be the connector: act as the go-to person for day-to-day questions, guiding colleagues and visitors through processes with clarity and care.

Job requirements

- You bring experience in office management, administration, or a PA role.
- You are a people person: approachable, professional, and always ready to support colleagues and guests with a smile.
- You have excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with an eye for detail, and you enjoy taking ownership of organizational tasks.
- You are fluent in German and English, both spoken and written.
- You thrive in dynamic, young teams and enjoy wearing multiple hats.
- Experience with office tools (MS Office, HR/admin systems).

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Enterprise Architect (m/f/d) Strategic Domains (Cloud-Architect)
employer: Heraeus Consulting & IT Solutions GmbH, HRdirekt
description:
As Enterprise Architect – Strategic Domains (m/f/d), you will help shape the future Enterprise Architecture practice within the Heraeus Group, with a particular focus on strategically important business and IT domains.

You will work at the interface of business strategy, IT roadmap and transformation portfolio, creating transparency, direction and architectural guidance for complex cross-domain topics.

Your key responsibilities will include:

- Shaping and evolving enterprise architecture practices across strategically relevant domains, ensuring alignment with business priorities, IT strategy and long-term transformation goals.
- Developing capability- and location-spanning reference architectures and strategic target architectures that provide clear orientation for future business and IT decisions.
- Supporting portfolio and investment decisions with architectural impact assessments, transparency and pragmatic recommendations.
- Coaching business and IT stakeholders in top-down architecture planning and helping translate strategic objectives into clear architectural priorities and roadmaps.
- Contributing to the further development of architecture governance, principles, standards and guardrails to enable consistent and value-driven architecture decisions across central and local domains.
- Moderating architecture discussions and helping stakeholders find viable solutions that balance business needs, technological options and economic considerations.
- Building strong partnerships with business functions, IT teams, domain experts and architects across the organization.
- Advising business and IT teams on architectural best practices while ensuring alignment with defined Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines.

What you can look forward to:

- role with real impact: you will help shape strategic domains and contribute to the future direction of Enterprise Architecture within an international group.
- A broad variety of exciting topics across business and IT, with the opportunity to work across organizational boundaries.
- The chance to create transparency, simplify complexity and enable better decisions in a dynamic transformation environment.
- A collaborative team culture where ownership, curiosity and pragmatic thinking are highly valued.
- The opportunity to act as a trusted advisor and enabler for business and IT stakeholders.

Your profile:

- Several years of experience in enterprise architecture, business architecture, domain architecture, IT strategy or a comparable role in a complex, preferably international organization.
- Understanding of enterprise architecture methods, target architecture development, architecture governance, principles and standards.
- Ability to translate business strategies and domain-specific requirements into clear, pragmatic architectural guidance without getting lost in unnecessary technical detail.
- Good understanding of current technological trends, innovations and state-of-the-art solutions, as well as their relevance for business transformation.
- Experience in facilitating architecture decisions and aligning different stakeholder perspectives across business, IT and architecture.
- A hands-on architecture driven mindset and the motivation to actively support architecture concepts from early idea to practical implementation together with business and IT teams.
- Strong communication, moderation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural topics clearly and convincingly to different audiences.
- Fluent German and English skills.
- Certifications such as TOGAF or equivalent qualifications are an advantage.
- You enjoy working independently, taking ownership and contributing as a motivated team player who wants to make a visible difference.

What we offer:

- Strong salary package - attractive base salary plus bonus and support for private pension plan
- Modern working time arrangements - time sovereignty without time recording, focus on results-oriented work
- Regular time off - 30 days annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company closures on bridge days and between years), special leave for specialoccasions, life phase account for paid time off (e.g. sabbatical, earlier retirement)
- Additional benefits - subsidized public transport, discounts in many (online) stores, company medical service with comprehensive preventive medical check-ups, sports facilities and employee canteen with freshly prepared meals every da
- Sustainability and social commitment - sustainability as part of the corporate strategy and targeted support for initiatives in the areas of education, family and science through our own foundations

Sounds like you?

Then we look forward to meeting you. Join us and help shape architecture that creates transparency, enables better decisions and supports the future development of the Heraeus Group.

description:
Regionalleitung Eingliederungshilfe (m/w/d)

Projekt HABITAS • Jugendhilfe Nordwestbrandenburg e.V.

- Beginn: Ab sofort
- Anstellungsart: Unbefristet / Vollzeit
- Einsatzbereich: Ostprignitz-Ruppin & Havelland

Über uns & das Projekt HABITAS

Der Jugendhilfe Nordwestbrandenburg e.V. setzt sich mit dem Projekt HABITAS für eine zukunftsweisende, bürgernahe Eingliederungshilfe ein.

Betreuungserfolg ist für uns dann erlebbar, wenn die Zahl stationärer Heimplätze für chronisch psychisch kranke und geistig behinderte Menschen sinkt, Betroffene in ihrem gewohnten Umfeld verbleiben können und die Rückgewinnung von Eigenverantwortlichkeit und Selbstwirksamkeit gelingt. Unter dem Leitsatz „Teilhabe gestalten – mitten im Leben und im vertrauten Sozialraum“ schaffen wir als Träger partnerschaftliche „Wir-Räume“ und verbinden professionelle Assistenz auf Augenhöhe mit den natürlichen Ressourcen des Lebensumfelds.

Zur fachlichen und strategischen Leitung unserer regionalen Angebote suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine engagierte und führungserfahrene Persönlichkeit als Regionalleitung (m/w/d) für die Region Ostprignitz-Ruppin und Havelland.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

- Team- & Mitarbeiterführung: Wertschätzende Führung, Motivation und fachliche Begleitung eines multiprofessionellen pädagogischen Teams von ca. 35 Mitarbeitenden.
- Konzeptionelle Steuerung & Qualitätssicherung: Fachliche und organisatorische Leitung unserer differenzierten Wohnformen:
- Appartementwohnen: Passgenaue Hilfen und verbindliche Strukturen bei hohem Betreuungsbedarf zur Vermeidung einer stationären Überversorgung.
- Appartementwohnen PLUS: Ambulante, stationär-ersetzende Wohnbegleitung für Klientinnen und Klienten mit intensiverem Assistenzbedarf.
- Ambulant unterstütztes Wohnen mit Assistenz: Individuelle Assistenz zur Förderung einer selbstständigen Lebensführung im eigenen Wohnraum.
- Wirtschaftlichkeit & Gremien: Führen von Kosten- und Leistungsverhandlungen mit Kostenträgern sowie engagierte Mitarbeit in internen und externen Fachgremien.
- Netzwerk- & Kooperationsarbeit: Enge, verlässliche Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, rechtlichen Betreuungen, Vermietern und Akteuren des Sozialraums.
- Weiterentwicklung: Strategischer Ausbau inklusiver und bürgernaher Unterstützungsstrukturen nach SGB IX.

Ihr Profil

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Sozialpädagogik, Gesundheitsmanagement / Sozialmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. ein Abschluss in einem ähnlichen Berufsfeld.
- Berufserfahrung: Fundierte praktische Erfahrungen in der Eingliederungshilfe (SGB IX) sowie im Umgang mit psychisch erkrankten und geistig beeinträchtigten Menschen.
- Führungskompetenz: Mehrjährige Berufs- bzw. Leitungserfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung sowie ein kooperativer, motivierender Führungsstil.
- Verhandlungsgeschick: Fundierte Kenntnisse im Sozialrecht, Verhandlungssicherheit mit Kostenträgern und Behörden.
- Haltung: Hohe Identifikation mit unserem Leitbild der Inklusion, Selbstwirksamkeit und Sozialraumorientierung.

Unser Angebot

- Verantwortungsvolle Leitungsfunktion mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
- Unbefristeter, zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz bei einem etablierten Träger
- Attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung
- 30 Tage Urlaub pro Kalenderjahr
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten & regelmäßige Home-Office-Tage
- Unterstützung und administrative Entlastung durch ein kleines, kompetentes Büroteam

title: Anleitung für Arbeitsmaßnahme in Teilzeit (19,35 h/Woche) für im Bereich Gala/Umweltbildung (Gärtner/in - Garten- und Landschaftsbau)
description:
Über uns

Pro Regio gGmbH wurde 1994 gegründet und engagiert sich seitdem für die gesellschaftliche Teilhabe benachteiligter Menschen im Kreis Rendsburg-Eckernförde und in Kiel. Wir sind ein gemeinnütziger Träger, der Menschen in schwierigen Lebenssituationen begleitet und dabei Teilhabe, Selbstbestimmung und soziale Gerechtigkeit in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam mit Partner:innen aus Gesellschaft, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft entwickeln wir nachhaltige Lösungen für soziale und ökologische Herausforderungen – transparent, respektvoll und engagiert.

Die Stelle

Seit 1996 befindet sich das  UmweltInfoZentrum am Noorwanderweg in Eckernförde und bietet zu jeder Jahreszeit zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, Natur hautnah zu entdecken und in unseren vielfältigen Gartenbereichen Umweltbewusstsein zu entwickeln.

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Anleitung für ein motiviertes Team von Teilnehmenden in einer Arbeitsgelegenheit mit Mehraufwandsentschädigung (AGH) im Umweltzentrum. Teilnehmende in Arbeitsgelegenheiten bewirtschaften unter Anleitung die Gärten des Zentrums.Die Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich: Von Gartenpflege über Obst- und Gemüseernte bis hin zu handwerklichen Tätigkeiten.

Die Arbeitszeit umfasst dabei 19,35 h/Woche, verteilt auf Montag bis Freitag, idealerweise am Vormittag. Da die Tätigkeit im Rahmen einer Projektförderung erfolgt, ist die Stelle zunächst befristet bis zum 31.08.2027. Eine Verlängerung ist angestrebt.  

Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Fachliche Anleitung: Praktische Unterweisung der Teilnehmenden in gärtnerischen Tätigkeiten, insbesondere im Bereich GaLa-Projekte (z. B. Ökologische Gestaltung von Grünflächen, nachhaltige Projektarbeit)
- Personalverantwortlichkeit: Aufnahme von Teilnehmenden, Berichtswesen (in Stepnova), Personalgespräche und Feedbackgespräche
- Organisation: Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Arbeitsabläufen und Teilnehmendendaten im Projekt.
- Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Team im Bereich Arbeitsgelegenheiten, dem Jobcenter und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen.
- Nachhaltigkeit: Umsetzung von umweltpädagogischen Konzepten und praxisnahen Lerninhalten.

Ihr Profil:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im gartenlandschaftlichen, gärtnerischen Bereich oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung im Umweltbereich.
- Erfahrung in der Anleitung von Gruppen, idealerweise in Arbeitsgelegenheiten oder ähnlichen Projekten.
- Freude an Umweltbildung und praktischer Arbeit (z. B. Gartenbau, Naturprojekte), idealerweise mit Kettensägenschein und Arbeitssicherheitsfortbildung
- Soziale Kompetenz und Geduld im Umgang mit Teilnehmenden unterschiedlicher Hintergründe, sowie Teamfähigkeit und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
- Führerschein Klasse B und BE

Wir bieten:

- Kurzfristiger Einstieg möglich
- Ein abwechslungsreiches und sinnstiftendes Aufgabenfeld im Bereich Arbeitsmarktintegration, Umweltbildung, und Nachhaltigkeit
- Mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache
- Arbeitsplatz im Grünen mit einem multiprofessionellen Team
- Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung des Projekts und der pädagogischen Konzepte.
- Vergütung in Anlehnung an Tv-L SH.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: 3D Artist
description:
Fenris Creations is looking for a 3D Artist with generalist range to join the EVE Online art team in our Reykjavik studio.

New Eden is built from hard surface ships and structures, station interiors, props and environments, along with the materials and lighting that hold them together. Some of that work starts from finished concept art. Some of it starts from a conversation and a rough direction, and needs an artist who can design in 3D rather than wait for someone else to draw it first. This role covers both.

You will own assets from early visual development through modelling, texturing and final polish in the CARBON engine, including any VFX pass the asset needs to read properly in game.

Your Tasks:
Create high quality, production ready 3D assets from concept art or, when required, develop original asset designs independently and in close collaboration with the Art Director and the wider art team, using 3D tools to explore shape language, function, proportion, scale and visual identity.
Take ownership of assigned assets and drive them from initial idea through final delivery, including design, high and low poly modelling, UVs, LODs, texturing, materials, VFX and final polish.
Ensure assets meet established artistic, technical and performance standards, working with Technical Art and Engineering to stay inside memory and performance budgets without giving up visual fidelity. Contribute ideas that improve visual quality, consistency and production workflows.
Participate actively in idea development within the art department, and collaborate with concept, VFX, technical art, design and engineering. Present work clearly, respond constructively to feedback and iterate efficiently.
Manage your own priorities and identifying problems, opportunities and next steps. Estimate tasks, communicate progress and raise risks or blockers early.

Your Profile:
Approximately three to five years of professional experience creating 3D assets for games, or a portfolio demonstrating an equivalent level of ability and production experience including work taken through a complete real-time pipeline. Strong modelling, texturing and material creation skills, with a solid grounding in PBR authoring and an understanding of how a real-time renderer will treat your work.
Ability to create assets from established concept art, and to develop original designs from broader creative direction. Strong understanding of shape language, form, proportion, scale, composition and visual hierarchy.
Confident with industry standard 3D and 2D software, for example Maya, Blender and Photoshop. Working knowledge of real-time optimisation and technical constraints, including topology, LODs, texture budgets and draw call cost, and comfortable working in an in-house engine and toolset.
Ability to create or contribute to VFX passes so that an asset reads correctly in game. You do not need to be a VFX specialist, but you do need to be able to finish your own assets rather than hand them on for someone else to complete.
Able to work independently, take ownership of an asset from initial idea to final delivery, and drive it forward without waiting to be asked. Comfortable presenting work, receiving direct critique, iterating quickly, and contributing to creative discussion across disciplines and departments. Clear communicator in written and spoken English.
An interest in science fiction design and the visual universe of EVE Online.

Nice to have:
Deeper VFX ability.
Scripting in Python.
A history of contributing to open source graphics, tooling or content pipeline projects.

What We Can Offer You:
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!
