title: OPERATEUR AMIANTE F/H
description:
Fort des compétences de sa filiale de démolition XARDEL, acquise en 2011, le Groupe COSTANTINI est en mesure de réaliser tous types de travaux de démolition et de déconstruction sélective, jusqu'au tri et la revalorisation des matériaux.


Avec un parc matériel spécifique de plus de 30 machines et une équipe d'opérateurs confirmés, nous sommes capables de proposer des solutions techniques à des démolitions d'immeubles de plus de 30 mètres de hauteur, des ouvrages d'art de tous types, des usines, des maisons individuelles ou même des démolitions intérieures pour réhabilitation.


Nous sommes également en mesure de réaliser des travaux de désamiantage intérieurs ou extérieurs dans le cadre de nos opérations.


La démolition est un métier technique et parfois complexe. Nous avons le savoir-faire et les moyens techniques pour vous accompagner dans vos travaux futurs.


Pour renforcer son équipe de Niederkorn (LU), XARDEL recherche un Opérateur Amiante F/H


Responsabilités :


L'Opérateur Amiante F/H effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,

    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi,

    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,

    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones) en respectant les consignes de sécurité,

    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,

    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,

    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).


Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),

    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),

    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,

    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),

    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),

    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),

    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.


Compétences utiles :

    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.

    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,

    Parcours de formation

title: Senior Unified Communications Engineer — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (H/F) — CDI à temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions ? XXXX Group est à la recherche d'un Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées pour concevoir, déployer et supporter des environnements de téléphonie Cisco et Microsoft Teams avancés pour ses clients.

Mission

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.
• Socle réseau IT solide: TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS voix de bout en bout.
• La téléphonie Microsoft Teams est idéale: Teams Phone, Direct Routing, intégration SBC, politiques de routage voix et scénarios hybrides Cisco/Teams.
• Conception et ingénierie de solutions : design de plan de numérotation, haute disponibilité et redondance, Call Admission Control et dimensionnement.
• Dépannage avancé à l'aide des traces SIP/SDL, de RTMT, du Dialed Number Analyzer et de captures réseau (Wireshark).
• Compétences en gestion de projet et en documentation : capacité à piloter des projets techniques et à produire une documentation claire et structurée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Environnement de travail

Le poste est basé au Luxembourg et combine des activités de projet et de conception avec des interventions sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité, la précision et la communication sont essentielles.
Ce poste conviendra à un professionnel expérimenté souhaitant prendre en charge des projets complexes de communications unifiées, approfondir son expertise sur les solutions

Cisco et Microsoft, et devenir un référent technique au sein d'un intégrateur ICT de premier plan.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

Contraintes éventuelles liées au poste:  Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

À propos de XXXX Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, XXXX Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et les Institutions européennes.
XXXX Group (XXXX, XXXX Security, XXXX Telecom et XXXX Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.

title: Lead System Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Entwicklung – Luxemburg / Remote (1720) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. - Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe

- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher

- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter

- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg

title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.

If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.

Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

title: Responsable Administratif et financier RAF (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches


Responsable Administratif et Financier
Rattachement hiérarchique
Direction Générale


Contexte de l'entreprise:

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation opérationnelle et du futur départ de notre actuelle Directrice Administrative d'ici fin 2026, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Dans notre environnement d'entreprise multiculturel (allemand, français, luxembourgeois) d'installation et maintenance HVAC, ce poste combine des fonctions de pilotage opérationnel, de contrôle de gestion rigoureux et de supervision transversale.


Missions et Responsabilités Clés:

Le/la RAF aura la responsabilité de superviser les quatre grands piliers de notre administration :

1. Management Général et Opérationnel

Assurer le pilotage de l'organisation administrative globale et le support au quotidien (informatique, événements, parc automobile, matériel).
Manager l'équipe de l'administration : piloter la répartition des tâches, assurer la montée en compétences et gérer les absences et suppléances.
Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)

- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten

- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office

- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

title: Investment Strategist Local SPOC (m/f)
description:
Investment Strategist – Local SPOC

locations
Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)
time type
Full time
job requisition id
REQ-10120039

Your role & work environment

The Investment Strategist is part of the Global Investment Center within ISIM in Luxembourg. The role focuses on building and articulating ING's investment vision from a macro and multi asset perspective, ensuring full alignment between global strategy and the Luxembourg platform.

As the local SPOC, the Investment Strategist works closely with Private Bankers and commercial teams, acting as the key relay for investment insights and ensuring consistent communication of ING's house view across the market.

ISIM, ING's “Super ManCo”, manages both UCITS and AIFs and acts as the Group's central platform for investment fund solutions.
Your key responsibilities

Drives Vision – Macro & Tactical Asset Allocation

• Conduct macroeconomic and market research to shape ING's investment vision.
• Analyze internal and external sources, build scenarios, and produce high-quality investment materials.
• Monitor macroeconomic developments and financial markets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Synthesize complex information into actionable investment insights supporting the monthly investment cycle.
• Contribute to ING's global investment strategy through cross-asset allocation views.
• Translate macroeconomic perspectives into portfolio positioning guidelines.
• Support the performance of centrally managed portfolios and long-term value creation.
• Collaborate closely with the CIO and investment strategists in Brussels and Amsterdam to align local and global investment strategies.

Communication & Strategic Alignment

• Act as the local point of contact for communicating ING's investment vision in Luxembourg.
• Provide regular market updates and investment insights to Private Bankers and commercial teams.
• Prepare and deliver presentations on market developments and investment themes.
• Represent ING's investment views at client events and group presentations.
• Support selected media interactions by communicating aligned investment messages.
• Ensure consistency and alignment with the Global Investment Center's investment strategy and messaging.

We look for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.

As an Investment Strategist – local SPOC you will also need:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or a related field (CFA charter holder is considered as an asset)
• Minimum of 10+ years of experience in financial markets as Portfolio Manager or Investment Strategist, with a proven track record in macro analysis and multi asset allocation.
• Excellent command of English and French (written and spoken), speaking Dutch or any other European language is considered as an asset.
• Strong expertise in macroeconomics, market analysis and cross asset dynamics, with the ability to identify key trends, risks and structural shifts.
• Proven capacity to translate complex macro and market signals into clear, actionable investment views and coherent portfolio positioning guidelines.
• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills, including scenario analysis and data driven decision making, delivering concise and high impact insights to committees, CIO, PMs and senior stakeholders.
• Proven collaboration skills in a global investment environment, working closely with Strategists across locations (Amsterdam, Brussels) and with the CIO. This includes potential (regular) travels.
• Excellent communication skills to support strategic alignment with commercial teams and act as a local SPOC for the Global Investment Center.
• High degree of autonomy, intellectual curiosity and ability to operate effectively in fast moving market environments.
• Excellent presentation skills (orally and powerpoint) for internal and external audiences (including panel discussions with peers) with the capability to present complex matters in (1) an easy way and (2) keep your audience captivated.
• Contribute to strategic projects with your relevant management, including taking ownership on relevant change projects if and when possible.

We offer you  

• Shape ING's investment vision and contribute directly to the performance of centrally managed portfolios.
• Collaborate with leading investment professionals across Luxembourg, Brussels, and Amsterdam in a truly international setting.
• Take ownership of strategic projects and influence key investment decisions in a dynamic and fast-evolving market environment.

We redefine banking. What about you?

There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centered around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that!

title: Senior Risk Analyst - Credit Risk Modelling (m/f/d)
description:
Senior Risk Analyst - Credit Risk Modelling (m/f/d)

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. We are looking for a  

Senior Risk Analyst - Credit Risk Modelling (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at our location in Luxembourg – flexible working conditions available

title: Business Line Manager – Pay & Credit (m/f/d)
description:
Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

We are looking for a

Business Line Manager – Pay & Credit (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at our location in Luxembourg – flexible working conditions are available

As Business Line Manager – Pay & Credit, you will work directly with the Business Line Lead to help shape and execute Riverty's Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and consumer credit business across Europe.

You will take ownership of selected strategic and cross-functional topics and drive them from the initial business question through analysis, stakeholder alignment and decision-making to implementation and performance follow-up.
Working across Product, Underwriting, Risk, Finance, Sales, Marketing and Operations, you will act as a cross-functional integrator — connecting different perspectives, creating transparency on dependencies and trade-offs, and making sure decisions turn into action.  
The role combines project management, strategy, business development and analytical thinking. You might develop the business case for a new proposition, assess a growth opportunity, coordinate an underwriting decision, conduct an ad-hoc business analysis or drive a strategic initiative across multiple functions.

What You'll Do

• Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives from initial business question through decision and implementation, coordinating stakeholders, milestones, dependencies and actions.  
• Support strategy and business performance by analysing key business drivers, identifying opportunities and translating insights into actionable recommendations.  
• Develop new business opportunities by assessing propositions, partnerships and other growth initiatives from a strategic and commercial perspective.  
• Build and challenge business cases, combining commercial, financial, product, operational and risk perspectives to support investment and management decisions.  
• Coordinate underwriting and credit performance topics, assessing implications for conversion, credit losses, volumes, customer experience and profitability.  
• Support key Business Line steering and governance forums, ensuring topics are properly structured, decisions are prepared and agreed actions are followed through.  
• Connect stakeholders across Riverty, creating alignment between functions and ensuring complex initiatives move forward.  
The scope reflects the core responsibilities in the underlying role profile across enablement, strategy, development, business cases, underwriting and governance.  

What You'll Bring

• Around 5 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, business development, project/program management, financial services, corporate finance or a comparable cross-functional role.  
• Proven ability to drive complex projects across multiple stakeholders, including where you do not have direct authority over the teams involved.  
• Strong analytical capabilities and experience with business cases, financial modelling and management decision support.  
• Ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems and turn them into clear actions and decisions.  
• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, combined with commercial thinking and a hands-on approach.  
• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.  
• Experience in payments and/or consumer credit is a plus, but not a prerequisite.  
• Fluent English

Why This Role?

Pay & Credit sits at the intersection of product, commercial, finance, credit risk and operations. That puts you at the center of some of Riverty's most important business questions.
Working directly with the Business Line Lead, you will gain significant exposure to the strategic and financial steering of Pay & Credit, while building a broad network across Riverty and developing an end-to-end understanding of the business.  
Your mandate: connect the dots, create structure, enable decisions and drive execution — while helping shape where Pay & Credit goes next.

Job Description

As part of the continued build-out of our Treasury function in Luxembourg, we are looking for a Treasury Manager to play an active role in the implementation and execution of treasury activities, including liquidity management, cash management, treasury trading, risk monitoring, and process development. This role will contribute to establishing robust treasury processes, controls, and operating procedures within a regulated banking environment.

We are looking for a

Treasury Manager (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at our location in Luxembourg – flexible working conditions are available

Your responsibilities:

• Participate in the implementation and continuous enhancement of Treasury processes, controls, and operating procedures.
• Establish and maintain treasury workflows covering liquidity management, treasury trading, hedging activities, and cash management.
• Manage daily liquidity positions and cash balances to ensure adequate liquidity levels.
• Monitor, manage, and optimise nostro account balances and related cash flows.
• Prepare and monitor short- and medium-term liquidity forecasts.
• Execute treasury transactions, including money market placements, FX transactions, hedging transactions, and securities trades.
• Monitor and analyse liquidity, foreign exchange, interest rate, counterparty, and concentration risks arising from treasury activities.
• Calculate and monitor liquidity and risk metrics, including LCR, NSFR, liquidity gaps, and other treasury-related indicators.
• Ensure treasury activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

Qualifications

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
• 3+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Liquidity Management, Financial Markets, or a comparable role within a regulated financial institution.
• Hands-on experience in cash management, liquidity monitoring, money market transactions, FX operations, securities trades, and nostro account management.
• Experience in calculating, monitoring, and analysing liquidity and risk metrics, including LCR, NSFR, liquidity gaps, and treasury-related risk indicators.
• Familiarity with CSSF requirements and applicable European regulatory frameworks affecting treasury activities.
• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment and collaborate effectively with Finance, Risk, Operations, and other stakeholders.
• Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

• Provide our Japanese-speaking and English-speaking clients with the best quality they can expect
• Assist in all administrative matters related to the department activities, including planning, presentation and business development
• Maintain / update various reports and fund lists
• Follow regulatory developments

Job requirements:

• Degree in Finance, Business Administration or related field
• Fluency in Japanese and English (written and spoken) is mandatory
• Moderate experience in the financial industry, ideally in fund administration in Japan
• Knowledge in alternative investments (e.g. private equity funds) is a plus
• Successful track record in building and maintaining client relationships with strong interpersonal skills and self-motivation
• High professional approach in all contacts, risk awareness, customer and quality minded

• Flexibility, open-mindedness and team spirit are highly appreciated assets

description:
Dein Job in Luxemburg!

SiFa Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d) in Luxembourg

OG Recruitment ist Ihre Beratungsagentur für die Vermittlung von SpezialistInnen und Führungskräften in Luxemburg und der Grenzregion. Bei uns geht es ausschließlich um direkte Personalvermittlungen zu unseren Auftraggebern.

Für unseren renommierten Auftraggeber mit Sitz in Luxemburg-Stadt suchen wir ab sofort eine Sicherheitsfachkraft (m/w/d).

Ihre Mission ist die Umsetzung und Einhaltung sowie die Risikobeurteilung der Arbeitssicherheit auf der Baustelle und im Büro.

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes, ausführendes Unternehmen für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung innerhalb einer namhaften luxemburgischen Firmengruppe mit spannenden Projekten und einem offenen und modernen Arbeitsumfeld.

Die Stelle wird im Rahmen der direkten Personalvermittlung mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Sie sind Ansprechpartner/in für alle sicherheitsrelevanten Fragen und koordinieren den Informationsaustausch zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen und externen Partnern
- Sie überwachen und kontrollieren die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und -standards im gesamten Unternehmen
- Sie führen die Sicherheitsunterweisungen und Schulungen zur Arbeitssicherheit in den Büros sowie auf den Baustellen durch
- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Analysen und Auswertungen der Risiken für die Arbeitssicherheit der Mitarbeitenden
- Sie entwickeln und implementieren die Sicherheitskonzepte und -maßnahmen und sind für die Risikobewertung und Unfalluntersuchungen zuständig
- Sie führen die Gefahrenanalyse sowie die Bestandsaufnahme durch (Postes à risques, STM)
- Sie sorgen für die Umsetzung der Managementsysteme im Bereich Arbeitsschutz
- Das Sicherheitsregister wird von Ihnen gepflegt und aufrechterhalten
- Sie nehmen regelmäßig an Sicherheitsmeetings teil und verfassen und publizieren monatliche Sicherheitsanweisungen
- Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit
- Sie sind für den einwandfreien Ablauf der behördlichen Kontrollen zuständig
- Sie organisieren die internen, externen und Baustellenaudits für die Sicherheit sowie ISO 45001
- Etwa 2-3 Mal pro Woche sind Sie vor Ort auf den Baustellen, führen Dokumentationen, erstellen Berichte und erledigen weitere administrative Aufgaben

Ihr Profil

- Sie bringen eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (Sifa) im Bauwesen mit und verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium mit der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder haben eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker / Meister oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss

- Sie können mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Sicherheitsbeauftragte(r) vorweisen
- Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Sicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz am Arbeitsplatz
- Sie haben die Qualifizierung zum Schulungsleiter (von Vorteil)
- Sie haben ein sehr gutes technisches Verständnis
- Sie sind offen und kommunikativ im Austausch mit Mitarbeitern und arbeiten gerne im Team
- Sie sprechen fließend Deutsch und haben gute Kenntnisse in Französisch

Das wird Ihnen geboten

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag direkt beim Auftraggeber
- Eine attraktive Vergütung
- Gutes Betriebsklima und moderne Arbeitsumgebung
- Zukunftssichere Perspektive mit aussichtsreichen Karrieremöglichkeiten
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

title: Operations Analyst (m/f)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operations Analyst - New Issues, you will play a key role in supporting securities operations through the analysis, onboarding, monitoring, and maintenance of financial instruments. This position offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of products while contributing to data quality, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance within an international banking environment.

RESPONSABILITIES

Securities Documentation and Analysis

• Review and analyze securities documentation, including prospectuses, final terms, key information documents, term sheets, issuer notices and other supporting documents.
• Assess documentation for completeness, consistency and operational usability before the instrument is created or maintained in the Bank's systems.
• Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies or unclear product features and coordinate clarification with issuers, arrangers, custodians and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain a complete and traceable repository of instrument documentation for operational, audit and regulatory purposes.

Instrument Data Validation

• Validate instrument static data and key economic characteristics, including ISIN, issuer, currency, coupon, maturity, underlying, payment frequency, call features and market classification.
• Ensure instrument data recorded in internal systems is complete, accurate and consistent with the official documentation and approved data sources.
• Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate timely correction with relevant internal teams and external data providers.
• Perform periodic data-quality reviews and support control evidence and audit-trail requirements.

Pricing and Tolerance Controls

• Perform daily or periodic pricing controls and review price movements against established tolerance thresholds.
• Investigate missing, stale or out-of-tolerance prices and obtain supporting information from approved market data sources, issuers or valuation providers.
• Escalate material pricing exceptions and ensure that corrections or overrides are appropriately supported, approved and documented.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of pricing-control procedures and tolerance parameters.

Fiscal Impacts and Fiscal Documentation

• Analyze potential fiscal impacts associated with financial instruments, income events, redemptions and other lifecycle events.
• Collect, validate and maintain fiscal documentation required for withholding-tax treatment, tax relief, reclaim processes and applicable reporting obligations.
• Coordinate with Tax, Compliance, custodians and issuers to clarify the fiscal treatment of instruments and specific events.
• Ensure fiscal assumptions, supporting evidence and operational instructions are clearly documented and escalated when uncertain.

Funds – NAV Control

• Monitor and control Net Asset Value (NAV) information for investment funds using approved sources.
• Investigate missing, stale or unusual NAV movements and coordinate resolution with fund administrators, custodians, distributors and data providers.
• Validate that fund prices and relevant reference data are correctly reflected in internal systems.
• Maintain supporting evidence for NAV exceptions, corrections and escalations.

Onboarding of Structured Products

• Coordinate the operational onboarding of structured products from initial request through instrument readiness.
• Review final terms, term sheets, payoff descriptions, issuer information, relevant risk indicators and operational settlement details.
• Coordinate instrument creation and data validation with internal functions and confirm that required documentation and regulatory information are available before activation.
• Track open onboarding items, dependencies and approvals, escalating issues that could prevent timely product availability.

Monitoring of Specific Events

• Monitor instrument-specific events and issuer notices that may affect product terms, valuation, client positions or operational processing.
• Analyze relevant event information, identify impacted instruments and coordinate required updates in the Bank's systems.
• Communicate material events and operational impacts to the relevant internal stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
• Maintain evidence of the analysis, decisions, actions and follow-up performed.
• Coordination with Issuers and External Parties
• Act as an operational point of contact with issuers, arrangers, custodians, fund administrators and data providers for instrument documentation, reference data, pricing and event-related queries.
• Coordinate the collection of missing information and follow up on outstanding requests within required operational timelines.
• Ensure communications and received documentation are retained in accordance with applicable internal record-keeping requirements.
• Escalate unresolved or material issues to the Senior Operations Analyst or Operations Manager.
• General Responsibilities
• Maintain clear and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Identify operational risks and opportunities to improve data quality, controls and process efficiency.
• Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, process documentation and operational projects.
• Execute assigned controls and reporting activities while maintaining accuracy, traceability and appropriate escalation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in securities operations, instrument data management, product onboarding, pricing controls, funds operations, or related areas.
• Strong understanding of financial instruments, including bonds, equities, investment funds, and structured products.
• Knowledge of securities documentation, instrument static data, and product lifecycle events.
• Understanding of pricing controls, tolerance monitoring, NAV validation, and related operational processes.
• Awareness of withholding tax documentation and tax-related operational impacts is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Fluent English is required; Portuguese is considered an advantage.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

This position is based in Luxembourg and primarily office-based. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. You will work closely with internal teams and external market participants, including issuers, custodians, fund administrators, and data providers. Successful candidates will demonstrate resilience, sound judgment, and a commitment to delivering accurate and timely operational outcomes while contributing to continuous process improvement. Occasional additional effort may be required to meet operational, regulatory, or project-related deadlines.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

At XXXX, diversity is both a value and a strategic priority. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are welcomed, respected, and valued.

If you are looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while contributing to the transformation of an international banking institution, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of XXXX's journey of trust, innovation, and sustainable growth.

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Economics, Engineering, or Information Technology (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
• Around 3-4 years of relevant experience in the banking industry, with demonstrated exposure to middle- and/or back-office operations.
• Solid knowledge of multiple banking value chains, including but not limited to:  

1. Payments & Cash Management
2. Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
3. Investment & Portfolio Management
4. Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
5. Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
6. Lombard & Collateral Management
7. Trade Finance
8. Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations

• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.
• Pragmatic, autonomous, solution-oriented, and comfortable working at speed across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to produce clear, structured, and professional documentation.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior leadership and subject matter experts.
• Fluent in English; French and/or any additional language is an asset.
• Ability to efficiently manage multiple deliverables and priorities in a fast-paced, high-ambition environment.

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable
specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

• Payments & Cash Management
• Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
• Investment & Portfolio Management
• Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
• Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
• Lombard & Collateral Management
• Trade Finance
• Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations
• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
