title: Researcher position in Early Earth Processes
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position in Early Earth Processes, available at the Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB), Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, University of Oslo (UiO).

The position is a full-time position for a period of 3 years.

Starting date no later than 01.01.2027.

Place of work is PHAB, the Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is associated with PHAB and linked to the research theme ‘Planets and Early Earth’, which addresses planet formation, evolution and comparative planetology to identify the initial conditions for habitability and how a planet’s composition and interior influence its ability to nurture a biosphere. The researcher will be part of a project group that explore the conditions for early life and Earth’s evolution as a habitable planet, and specifically, through geochemical investigations of ancient cratons and greenstone belts to understand habitable environments and key geological events (e.g., the Great Oxidation Event) to shed light on crustal and atmospheric processes during Archean-Paleoproterozoic times. The project requires considerable field and laboratory experience, and we seek a candidate with a strong Archean-Paleoproterozoic geological background with a proven record in early Earth surface processes, sedimentology, geobiology, micropaleontology, evolutionary processes, geochemistry and geochronology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geosciences. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Strong publication track record.
  • Extensive Archean craton and greenstone belt field experience.
  • Early Earth geobiological research background using stable isotope systematics (C, N, S, O) and Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS).
  • Experience with U-Pb zircon geochronology and Lu-Hf isotopic systematics.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience working in large-scale multi-partner projects.
  • Experience in paleo sea-temperature proxies and pH modelling of oceans.
  • Experience in advanced methods, e.g. high-resolution synchrotron-based techniques.  
  • Experience in fundraising.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 646000 to 745000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Your Project Vision (1 page) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity) 
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB) is a Norwegian Centre of Excellence that provides a stimulating and well-funded research environment. PHAB’s main goal, based on detailed studies of Earth and our solar system, is to develop predictive models to identify habitable planets around other stars. PHAB research activities comprise three interrelated research themes: (1) Planets and Early Earth, (2) Modern Earth and (3) Exo-Earths. The centre was established in 2023 and will consist of approximately 70 full time and part time professors and researchers, PhD Research Fellows and Postdoctoral Research Fellows.

Main responsibilities include:

title: Vil du lede et driftsteknikerteam med varierte og spennende arbeidsdager?
description:
I Coop Øst er det stor aktivitet, og spesielt i vår avdeling for butikk- og eiendomsutvikling skjer det mye. Vår driftstekniker og innleide vaktmestere har ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen våre 52 egeneiende eiendommer. For å møte veksten og den økte aktiviteten søker vi nå en teamleder.

Som teamleder vil du få ansvar for eget team med driftsteknikere/innleide vaktmestere, samtidig som du har ansvar for egen eiendomsportefølje på lik linje med de øvrige driftsteknikerne. Rollen passer for deg som trives med å kombinere praktisk og operativ eiendomsdrift med faglig oppfølging, planlegging, koordinering og teamlederansvar.

Butikk- og eiendomsutvikling i Coop Øst har ansvar for forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre butikker og eiendommer. Avdelingen teller 16 engasjerte ansatte med lang fartstid i bedriften, og det er 82 ansatte på hovedkontoret totalt. Per i dag forvalter Coop Øst ca. 287 000 m² eiendom med butikkdrift. Vi eier 52 eiendommer med butikkdrift (totalt 100 500 m²) som skal forvaltes og utvikles. Som teamleder for driftsteknikerne blir du en sentral bidragsyter i å sikre god struktur, effektiv ressursbruk og høy kvalitet i den operative eiendomsdriften.

Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026
Søkere vurderes fortløpende.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Som teamleder vil du både jobbe med egen portefølje og ha et tydelig teamlederansvar for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere. Du vil følge opp teamet og bidra til god planlegging og koordinering, samtidig som du sikrer at oppgaver prioriteres og løses på en strukturert måte. Rollen innebærer praktisk arbeid ute på eiendommene og daglig drift og tilsyn. Du vil ha oppfølging av tekniske anlegg, følge opp eksterne leverandører og serviceavtaler, samt gi bistand ved ombygginger, oppgraderinger og prosjekter. I tillegg vil du være en tydelig faglig ressurs og koordinator for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere, bidra til god fremdrift i oppgavene og sørge for at avdelingen har oversikt over status, behov og prioriteringer. Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til sikker, kostnadseffektiv og forutsigbar drift av eiendommene, samtidig som du skaper gode rammer for teamet ditt.

Coop Øst har hovedkontor på Kolbotn og eget lager for verktøy og utstyrrett i nærheten. Du må påregne reisevirksomhet mellom våre ulike eiendommer. Dette er en selvstendig og mobil rolle hvor du primært vil jobbe ute med egen eiendomsportefølje og samtidig skal bidra til å planlegge, koordinere og følge opp arbeidsoppgavene i teamet.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har yrkesfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne som tømrer, elektriker eller rørlegger eller er driftstekniker i dag. 
  • Det er en fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av næringseiendom.
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Førerkort klasse BE er påkrevd for stillingen. Kandidater som ikke har BE ved ansettelse må være villige til å gjennomføre og bestå førerprøven for klasse BE innen avtalt tid.
  • Det er viktig med gode samarbeidsevner og at du trives med en utadrettet og selvstendig arbeidshverdag.
  • I Coop Øst er vi opptatt av et godt arbeidsmiljø og det å være serviceinnstilt over dine kollegaer og våre samarbeidspartnere legger vi stor vekt på.
  • For god og grundig utførelsen av denne jobben er viktig å være strukturert og løsningsorientert


Hva kan du få hos oss?
Coop Øst er et fremoverlent samvirkelag hvor det skjer mye. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ansatte og legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs hos oss. Du kommer inn i et godt onboardingsprogram og vil oppleve at hovedkontoret består av mange serviceinnstilte og hjelpsomme kollegaer. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, telefonordning, arbeidsbil, helseforsikring og tilgang til firmahytter får du også. Som medeier og ansatt i Coop Øst får du 6% ansattrabatt/kjøpeutbytte. Ikke minst vil du få mange engasjerte og skikkelig dyktige kollegaer og jobb i et solid selskap. Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg i Coop Øst. 

Coop Øst bruker sertifiserte arbeidspsykologiske testverktøy fra Assessio i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi benytter SEMAC bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Hvis dette er noe for deg gleder vi oss til å se eller lese søknaden din:-)

Kundene våre gjenspeiler befolkingen og det vil vi at våre ansatte også skal gjøre. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og ønsker alle søkere velkommen, uansett bakgrunn, erfaring, funksjonsevne, kjønn, legning eller religion. Coop Øst ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver for alle.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Coop Øst SA er Norges største samvirkelag med en omsetning på 10,2 milliarder i 2025. Vi har ca. 4400 ansatte og 211 butikker i de 5 fylkene Østfold, Akershus, Oslo, Buskerud og Innlandet med hovedkontor på Kolbotn i Nordre Follo. Coop har 6 kjedekonsepter; Coop Prix, Coop Mega, EXTRA, Matkroken, Obs og Obs BYGG. Coop er den eneste aktøren innen detaljhandel som er eid av forbrukerne og baserer sin drift på delingsøkonomi og utbytte til alle medeiere. Coop er opptatt av bærekraft, og omtanke for mennesker, dyr og miljø blir stadig viktigere for oss. Derfor jobber vi kontinuerlig med å redusere vår klima- og miljøpåvirkning. Vi har blant annet en nullvisjon for kasting av mat og fokus på bærekraftige produkter. For å lese mer se www.coop.no/coop-og-barekraft

title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.


More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage

Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour

We need different perspectives in our work

description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements 

Qualification requirements

  • A PhD (or equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree) in global health, public health, epidemiology, medical sciences, social sciences with strong health focus, or a closely related field. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.
  • Documented experience with mixed-methods research (both quantitative and qualitative).
  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:
    • cohort or longitudinal data analysis
    • regression modelling
    • handling of routine health dataexperience with statistical software (e.g. Stata, R, or similar).
  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications

  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language and/or Kiswahili would be an asset.
  • Previous experience working East Africa/sub-Saharan Africa and in multidisciplinary and international teams will be an advantage.
  • Experience with social determinants of health, food security, or equity-focused analyses in health research is particularly desirable.
  • Experience in grant writing or participation in funding applications is an advantage.
  • Demonstrating previous experience of working with mixed-methods research, implementation research and working in a multidisciplinary team in low-resource settings would be an advantage. 

Personal skills

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is highly motivated to pursue an academic career.
  • Can work independently and systematically, while being an engaged team player.
  • Has strong organizational and project management skills and can handle complex coordination tasks across partners and countries.
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can communicate effectively with clinicians, researchers, students, community representatives and policymakers.
  • Can take initiative and demonstrate strong, equitable and shared leadership skills in an international, multidisciplinary environment, fostering co‑ownership among partners 
  • Is willing and able to spend longer periods in Tanzania (e.g. for fieldwork, coordination and collaboration).

title: Would you like to help shape the next chapter of Aimo Park’s commercial development?
description:
We are looking for a Commercial Director who will take a key position in Aimo Park Norway’s management team, with a clear mandate to strengthen the commercial organisation and drive further profitable growth.

The role:

As Commercial Director, you will have overall responsibility for New Business in Norway and lead the commercial sales team. You will identify new market opportunities, develop strong customer and partner relationships, and contribute to the development and commercialisation of new services, concepts and business models.

The role spans strategy and execution. You will develop the sales strategy, drive structured sales processes, identify new revenue opportunities and play a key role in major tenders, contract negotiations and commercial discussions. You will also work closely with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Legal, Technology and Marketing.

An important part of your mandate will be to further develop the commercial function - its people, processes and ways of working - ensuring that the organisation is equipped for continued growth.

You have:
  • a university degree in Business, Economics or equivalent
  • a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with a proven track record in commercial roles
  • solid experience in B2B sales and business development
  • proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and lead a commercial team
  • experience in strategic sales and in translating strategy into tangible commercial results
  • strong commercial and financial acumen
  • experience with complex customer processes, contracts and negotiations
  • an analytical approach and the ability to use data and market insight to identify opportunities for growth and profitability
  • excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
It is an advantage if you have:
  • experience from real estate or other transaction- and contract-intensive businesses
  • relevant industry experience
  • experience in developing and commercialising new services, concepts or business models
  • experience with partnerships and the development of new revenue streams
Who are you?

We believe you are self-driven, curious and results-oriented, with the ability to see both the bigger picture and what it takes to turn opportunities into tangible results.

You are comfortable challenging established ways of working, while doing so constructively. You build trust, bring people with you and combine analytical strength with creativity and commercial instinct. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating and developing, rather than simply managing what already exists.

Why Aimo Park?

At Aimo Park, you get the strength and stability of an established market leader - combined with the opportunities of a market undergoing rapid transformation.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth, and the next generation of products and capabilities will be critical to our success.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication. Operating in remote environments with only a small solar panel as its energy source, the collar must reliably deliver virtual fencing and continuous livestock monitoring under strict energy and connectivity constraints.

We're looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer who wants to build products that operate in the real world and have a direct impact on sustainable agriculture and animal welfare.


Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop embedded software for next-generation livestock monitoring devices

  • Lead firmware development from concept through deployment and field validation

  • Build reliable low-power systems using cellular, GNSS, wireless communication, sensors, and on-device machine learning

  • Work closely with hardware, cloud, and product teams to bring new features from concept to field deployment

  • Drive software quality, architecture, and technical best practices across the platform


We believe you have

  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development

  • Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing firmware for resource-constrained systems

  • Experience with modern embedded software architectures, development practices, and CI/CD

  • Experience building connected embedded systems and working with communication protocols

  • Solid understanding of low-power system design and energy-constrained devices

  • Experience with one or more of the following:

    • Cellular technologies (LTE-M, NB-IoT, 4G/5G)

    • GNSS

    • Bluetooth Low Energy and other wireless technologies

    • Sensor integration, signal processing, edge ML

    • Device management and OTA updates


We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments

  • Comfortable taking ownership and driving projects from idea to deployment

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering challenges

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams


We offer

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture

  • Challenging engineering problems in low-power, connected systems

  • Opportunity to shape industry-leading products during a period of international growth

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities

  • Competitive compensation and benefits


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Application deadline: August 16th 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

title: Localization Specialist
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.


Your Mission 

We are looking for a Localization Specialist on a temporary contract basis, running until the end of the year (with the possibility of extension) for a localisation project: English to Norwegian.

The Localization Specialist plays a critical role in bridging the gap between our global product offerings and regional markets. This role ensures that our digital content, educational resources, and other materials are not just translated but truly localized to resonate with our audiences.

You will ensure that every e-learning module, knowledge base article, and content asset feels native to the user, maintaining high standards for accuracy, tone, and accessibility across all digital touchpoints.


Core Responsibilities 

  • Core Localization & Translation:

    • Execute high-quality translations and localizations for primary languages.

    • Localize diverse content types, including e-learning, Knowledge Base articles, and high-impact customer communications (emails, guides).

  • AI & Workflow Innovation

    • Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to increase efficiency in translation and content adaptation while maintaining a "human-in-the-loop" approach for quality.

    • Ensure that AI-assisted content reflects the Mercell brand voice and local procurement nuances.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Act as an active collaborator within the Delivery Department to align localization needs with the broader content strategy.

    • Manage content review cycles, coordinating with product teams to ensure accuracy, and proactively revising localized materials based on internal feedback and product updates.

  • Technical Content & Quality:

    • Ensure "in-platform" accuracy by creating mock tenders to capture correct labels and screenshots for educational materials.

    • Maintain accessibility standards by writing and auditing alternative texts for digital imagery.

  • Content Maintenance:

    • Continuously update localized assets to reflect product developments, ensuring a seamless and consistent experience across all digital touchpoints and user-facing materials


Required Qualifications  

  • Linguistic Excellence: Native-level or C2 proficiency in Norwegian, with a deep understanding of local business nuances.

  • Digital Literacy: High proficiency in navigating SaaS platforms and content management tools.

  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to grammar, tone, and technical accuracy in a high-tempo environment.

  • Communication & Cooperation: Strong ability to coordinate between Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Delivery teams

  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple localization streams and meet tight deadlines.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Previous experience in localization, translation, or content management within a SaaS or international business environment. Experience within public procurement or regulated sectors is considered advantageous, but not required.

 

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Temporary contract basis (40hrs/week) until 31 December 2026 (with the possibility of extension)

Workplace type: Remote

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 23 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.


Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!


-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Release Manager
description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.


About The Role

We are looking for a dedicated Release Manager to own the execution and coordination of our quarterly releases, from the first planning session until the software is ready to be shipped to our customers.

This role is needed as the organization grows, and so does the complexity of our product development and engineering work. The Engineering teams are organised by discipline rather than by feature, which means deliveries depend on cross-team collaboration across Engineering, design, and testing. Until now, release coordination has been handled alongside other roles. As we scale, we need one person in Engineering who owns the release, sees the full picture and makes sure every team knows what it needs from the others to deliver on time and agreed quality.

You will make sure our releases are realistically scoped, that dependencies between teams surface early, and that code freeze, branch-off and backporting run smoothly. You will be the bridge between Product, who defines what we want to build, and Engineering, who knows what is possible. Going forward, you will also bring Operations, Customer Success and other stakeholders into a more structured release process.

Your impact in the first year. You will turn release coordination into a clear, repeatable system. Team Leads will know what they depend on and when. Stakeholders will have real-time visibility into progress and risks. Engineering teams will work towards goals that are predictable and achievable, without unsustainable pressure.


What success looks like after 6–12 months:

  • Public releases ship on time and with high quality

  • Delivery risks and issues are identified and addressed early

  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, scope changes and risks

  • Engineering teams experience predictable goals, and internal roadmaps become a source of motivation

  • Release processes are structured and scalable, and cross-team alignment has measurably improved

  • Release cadence is reduced to two months, without increased total overhead or decreased delivery quality


What You Will Do

  • Own the release end to end: Plan and run our quarterly public releases, from scoping to handover to Operations and Mission Readiness.

  • Make plans realistic: Work with stakeholders from Product and Engineering in the planning phase to turn requirements into scoped, achievable delivery plans that match engineering capacity.

  • Map and drive dependencies: Highlight inter-team dependencies across all engineering teams, design, test and Field Application Engineers.

  • Run the execution rhythm: Hold status meetings with Team Leads, track what is ahead of and behind schedule, and create action plans to avoid delay.

  • Manage risk and trade-offs: Identify risks and bottlenecks early, show the consequences of scope changes and delays, recommend mitigations and escalate when needed. You act as the buffer before change requests reach the engineering teams.

  • Create visibility and structure: Give leadership, Engineering, Product, and Operations clear reporting on progress and risks, and build release processes that scale as we grow.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a specialised technical project manager to be a dedicated Release Manager. You will sit in Engineering and work closely with the CTO, VP Engineering, Chief of Staff, Team Leads, Product, and Operations. You need to understand engineers well enough to sense how serious a problem is when they raise it, but you are not the technical owner of the deliverables and you won't dive deep into technical problem-solving. This role is currently standalone in ownership and highly collaborative in execution, without any director reports, however the function and team might expand over time.

  • Efficient and clear communicator

  • Around 5 years of relevant experience, for example as a technical project manager, development manager or release manager coordinating development across multiple teams in a Software or Product environment

  • An engineering or computer science background, ideally from software or combined hardware/software environments

  • Solid technical understanding of version control, CI/CD pipelines, development and testing environments, and modern software delivery processes, and confidence working in Jira

  • Highly structured and organised, with a proven ability to set up processes, plan, and manage risk across many stakeholders

  • Proactive by nature: you spot and fill gaps, and when one release is out, you are already planning the next

  • Strong people skills and clear communication, both written and verbal, with the ability to stay positive and light-hearted when things get stressful

  • Motivated by owning a critical function in a fast-moving startup and comfortable operating in ambiguity

It is a plus if you have hands-on experience with Git, a software engineering background, or experience from defence or innovation-driven product development. Experience from management or strategy consulting can also be highly relevant if combined with strong technical understanding.


Why You Should Join

  • Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

  • Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities.

  • Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

  • Ship work that matters. The things you build don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

  • Supported by great benefits. Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, equity potential, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.


Our Recruitment Process

We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

  • Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

  • First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

  • Second interview (60–90 min): A technical discussion, typically including a take-home assignment or case presentation.

  • Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!


Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.


Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we’ll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. Previous authorization or clearance is not required, but all candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary approvals if required for their role.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

title: Peppes Pizza Moa søker kokker, kjøkkenmedarbeidere og servitører!
description:
Vil du bli en del av teamet vårt på Peppes Pizza Moa? Vi søker engasjerte og serviceinnstilte kjøkkenmedarbeidere, kokker og servitører som ønsker å bidra til gode matopplevelser og et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø. Hos oss får du jobbe i et sosialt og aktivt team med fokus på kvalitet.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker både kokker, kjøkkenmedarbeidere og servitører som brenner for god mat, service og samarbeid.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er ansvarsbevisst, punktlig og pålitelig.

  • Har en positiv innstilling og godt humør.

  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø.

  • Er selvstendig, fleksibel og samarbeidsvillig.

  • Er opptatt av kvalitet, renslighet og god kundeservice.

  • Kan jobbe både dagtid, kvelder og helger.

  • Har erfaring fra restaurant, kjøkken eller service (en fordel, men ikke alltid et krav).

  • Er lærevillig og ønsker å utvikle deg.


For kokkestillingen er relevant kjøkkenerfaring spesielt ønskelig.

Vi verdsetter gode holdninger, samarbeidsevner og arbeidsvilje. Hos oss er det viktig at alle bidrar til et inkluderende og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Vi søker dyktige og motiverte medarbeidere til vårt team på Peppes Pizza Moa!

Arbeidsoppgaver for kjøkkenmedarbeidere og kokker:

  • Tilberedning av pizza og andre retter etter Peppes Pizzas standarder.

  • Forberedelse av råvarer og organisering av kjøkkenet.

  • Sikre god kvalitet, hygiene og matsikkerhet.

  • Sørge for orden og renhold på kjøkkenet.

  • Samarbeide med kollegaer for å sikre effektiv drift, også i travle perioder.


Arbeidsoppgaver for servitører:

  • Ta imot gjester på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte.

  • Ta bestillinger og servere mat og drikke.

  • Sørge for at gjestene får en god restaurantopplevelse.

  • Håndtere betaling og kasseoppgjør etter gjeldende rutiner.

  • Holde restauranten ryddig, ren og innbydende.

  • Samarbeide tett med kjøkkenet og resten av teamet.


Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du er positiv, pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Du liker å jobbe med mennesker og yte god service.

  • Du trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø.

  • Du er fleksibel og samarbeider godt med andre.

  • Du kan jobbe både selvstendig og i team.

  • Erfaring fra restaurant eller kjøkken er en fordel, men ikke et krav for alle stillingene.

  • Du har vilje til å lære og utvikle deg.

Vi tilbyr

Hos Peppes Pizza Moa ønsker vi å skape en arbeidsplass hvor medarbeiderne trives, utvikler seg og føler seg verdsatt.

Vi tilbyr:

Et hyggelig, inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø.

God opplæring og oppfølging.

En variert og spennende arbeidshverdag.

Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

Verdifull erfaring fra en kjent restaurantkjede.

Et godt team med fokus på samarbeid, kvalitet og trivsel.

Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter avtale og gjeldende regler.

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å bidra positivt til teamet vårt og være med på å skape gode opplevelser for gjestene våre.

Høres dette interessant ut? Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Peppes Pizza Moa er en del av den kjente og populære restaurantkjeden Peppes Pizza, som har lange tradisjoner innen pizza og restaurantopplevelser i Norge.

Vi holder til på Moa i Ålesund og ønsker å gi våre gjester gode matopplevelser, hyggelig service og en trivelig atmosfære.

Med nytt eierskap og store ambisjoner ønsker vi å videreutvikle restauranten og bygge et sterkt, positivt og engasjert team.

Hos oss står kvalitet, samarbeid, respekt og arbeidsglede i sentrum. Vi ønsker å skape en arbeidsplass der medarbeiderne trives, tar ansvar og får muligheten til å utvikle seg.

Bli med på reisen videre med Peppes Pizza Moa!

title: Daglig leder/rådgiver
description:
Vil du lede og utvikle Tannpleierforeningen?

Norsk Tannpleierforening søker daglig leder/rådgiver i fast 100 % stilling i Oslo.

Vil du bruke din erfaring fra ledelse, organisasjonsarbeid og arbeidsliv til å gjøre en forskjell? Hos oss får du en sentral rolle med ansvar for mennesker, drift og utvikling – og mulighet til å påvirke fremtiden til en engasjert fagforening.

Om Norsk Tannpleierforening

Norsk Tannpleierforening (NTpF) er en profesjons- og fagforening for tannpleiere i offentlig og privat sektor. Vi arbeider for medlemmenes lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, faglige utvikling og plass i helsetjenesten.

Vi er tilsluttet hovedorganisasjonen Unio og jobber for at forebygging, god tannhelse og tannpleiernes kompetanse skal få større gjennomslag.

Om stillingen

Som daglig leder/rådgiver har du ansvar for foreningens daglige drift, med budsjett-, økonomi- og personalansvar. Du kombinerer administrativ ledelse med medlemsrådgivning og utvikling av organisasjonen.

Du arbeider tett med foreningens politiske leder og hovedstyret og sørger for at beslutninger og prioriteringer blir fulgt opp i praksis. Du blir også en viktig støttespiller for ansatte, medlemmer, tillitsvalgte og lokale organisasjonsledd.

I en liten organisasjon får du både arbeide langsiktig og bidra i de praktiske oppgavene i hverdagen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Lede og videreutvikle foreningens daglige drift.

Ha budsjett- og økonomiansvar, med økonomistyring, rapportering og oppfølging.

Ha personalansvar og følge opp arbeidsmiljø og kompetanseutvikling.

Forberede styremøter og landsmøte og følge opp vedtak.

Gi medlemmer og tillitsvalgte råd om lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, tariffavtaler og arbeidslivsspørsmål.

Delta i og følge opp sentralt tariffarbeid.

Bidra til organisasjonsutvikling, medlemsrekruttering og opplæring av tillitsvalgte.

Samarbeide med Unio og andre relevante organisasjoner og fagmiljøer.

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

Relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne innen ledelse, administrasjon, økonomi eller arbeidsliv. Solid og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.

Erfaring fra ledelse og organisasjonsarbeid, gjerne fra en fagforening eller medlemsorganisasjon.

Erfaring med budsjett, økonomioppfølging og personalledelse.

Kunnskap om arbeidsliv, samarbeid mellom arbeidsgivere og arbeidstakere og tariffavtaler.

God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk.

God digital kompetanse.

Erfaring med medlemsrådgivning, forhandlinger og organisasjonsutvikling er en fordel. Kjennskap til helse- eller tannhelsefeltet er også verdifullt. Du trenger ikke være tannpleier for å søke.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker en trygg og tydelig leder som bygger tillit og får mennesker til å samarbeide. Du lytter, gjør gode vurderinger og følger opp beslutninger.

Vi ser etter deg som:

Skaper et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med rom for medvirkning og utvikling.

Arbeider selvstendig og strukturert og prioriterer når oppgavene er mange.

Tar initiativ og omsetter planer til handling.

Møter medlemmer og tillitsvalgte med respekt, omtanke og tydelighet.

Forstår samspillet mellom politisk ledelse, styret og administrasjonen.

Trives med både lederansvar og praktiske oppgaver i en liten organisasjon.

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr

En variert lederstilling med ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke foreningens utvikling.

Meningsfulle oppgaver som har betydning for medlemmene, arbeidslivet og helsetjenesten.

Tett samarbeid med engasjerte ansatte, tillitsvalgte og politisk ledelse.

Et bredt faglig og organisatorisk nettverk gjennom Unio.

Fleksibel arbeidshverdag og arbeidssted i Kirkegata 15 i Oslo.

Tariffavtale og gode pensjonsordninger.

Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Norsk Tannpleierforening er den eneste fag- og profesjonsforeningen for tannpleiere i Norge. Vi er et lite sekretariat med stort engasjement, og hver dag jobber vi for å styrke tannpleiernes rolle i helsevesenet og bidra til bedre oral helse i befolkningen.

Hos oss møter du mennesker som brenner for fag, politikk, arbeidsliv og folkehelse. Vi liker å diskutere store spørsmål, men er også opptatt av de små tingene som gjør hverdagen bedre for medlemmene våre.

HVA GJØR VI?

Kort fortalt jobber vi for at tannpleiere skal ha gode arbeidsvilkår, sterke fagmiljøer og mulighet til å bruke kompetansen sin fullt ut.

Det betyr blant annet at vi:

🦷 Gir råd og støtte til medlemmer

📢 Påvirker politikere og beslutningstakere

🤝 Samarbeider med andre organisasjoner i helse-Norge

📚 Bidrar til faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving

🌍 Jobber for bedre folkehelse og mindre sosial ulikhet

HVORDAN ER DET Å JOBBE HOS OSS?

Vi er en liten organisasjon, noe som betyr korte beslutningsveier og stor påvirkningsmulighet.

Vi representerer en profesjon som er helt sentral i det forebyggende helsearbeidet.

Tannpleiere møter mennesker i alle aldre og livsfaser, og bidrar hver dag til bedre helse, livskvalitet og mestring. Vår jobb er å sørge for at denne viktige kompetansen blir sett, verdsatt og brukt.

HVEM PASSER INN HOS OSS?

Det er ønskelig at du er tannpleier, men det er ikke et krav for å jobbe hos oss.

Det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, samfunnsengasjert, ivaretar samfunnsoppdraget til tannhelsetjenesten og liker å samarbeide med andre. Vi setter pris på mennesker som tar initiativ, ser løsninger og ønsker å gjøre en forskjell.

Sammen styrker vi tannpleiernes stemme, og bidrar til bedre helse for hele befolkningen.

title: Fast 100 % stilling som styrar i Søre Grindstugu barnehage
description:
Vågå kommune har to kommunale og ein privat barnehage, og vi søkjer ein engasjert og utviklingsorientert styrar som ønskjer å leie og vidareutvikle vår kommunale sentrumsbarnehage, Søre Grindstugu. Er det deg?

Som styrar vil du ha det overordna ansvaret for barnehagens pedagogiske, administrative og økonomiske drift, personalansvar, og dessutan bidra til eit godt og inkluderande arbeidsmiljø for tilsette, barn og føresette.

Vi har eit førebyggjande og tverrfagleg fokus, og alle tilsette på tvers av barnehagar, skular, PPT, helsestasjon og barnevernstenesta jobbar saman i laget rundt barn og unge.

Saman med UH-miljøet og samarbeidskommunar deltek Vågå i regionalt utviklingsarbeid. Dette bidreg til fagleg utvikling, systematisk, målretta og kontinuerleg arbeid for å gi gode tenester til barn og unge. Me har endringsvilje og er i jamn utvikling - med barna og unges beste i fokus.

Personalgruppa du vil leie består av kompetente og engasjerte medarbeidarar. I tillegg vil du bli ein del av ei dyktig leiargruppe, både i Vågå kommune som organisasjon men også innanfor oppvekstsektoren. Her vil du oppleve godt samhald og støtte, og få ein arena for læring og utvikling av tenesta og deg sjølv som leiar.

Arbeidsoppgåver

  • Overordna leiaransvar for barnehagedrifta og utvikling.

  • Personalansvar, inkludert oppfølging, rettleiing og kompetanseutvikling av tilsette.

  • Ansvar for budsjett, økonomistyring og ressursforvaltning.

  • Leie og koordinere utviklingsarbeid i tråd med gjeldande lovverk, rammeplan og lokale målsettingar.

  • Sikre høg kvalitet i det pedagogiske arbeidet.

  • Bygge gode relasjonar og samarbeid med barn, føresette og eksterne samarbeidspartnarar.

  • Samarbeide tett med styrar og tilsette i tilknytt barnehage for å utvikla felles praksis, dele kompetanse og utnytte ressursar på tvers av verksemdene.

  • Bidra til eit trygt, inkluderande og utviklande læringsmiljø for barn og tilsette.

Kvalifikasjonar

  • Godkjent barnehagelærarutdanning eller anna relevant pedagogisk utdanning i samsvar med krav i barnehagelova.

  • Leiarerfaring er ønskjeleg.

  • God kunnskap om økonomistyring og personalleiing.

  • God kjennskap til barnehagelova, rammeplanen og relevant regelverk.

  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.

Personlege eigenskapar

  • Tydeleg og inspirerande leiar.

  • Strategisk og utviklingsorientert.

  • Strukturert og vedtaksfør.

  • Relasjonssterk og inkluderande.

  • Evne til å motivere medarbeidarar og skape engasjement rundt utviklingsarbeid.

Vi tilbyr

  • Ei spennande og meiningsfull leiarstilling.

  • Moglegheit til å påverka og vidareutvikle barnehagetilbodet.

  • Samarbeid med dyktige kollegaer og leiarar i andre barnehagar og i oppvekstsektoren.

  • Faglege utviklingsmoglegheiter og støtte i leiarrolla.

  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter avtale.

Vi er på jakt etter ein leiar som kombinerer god økonomisk forståing med eit sterkt pedagogisk engasjement, og som ønskjer å utvikla barnehagen i tett samarbeid med tilsette, føresette og samarbeidande barnehagar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vågå kommune ligg i Nord-Gudbrandsdalen, midt mellom nasjonalparkane Jotunheimen og Rondane, omtrent midt mellom Oslo og Trondheim, med ei reisetid til begge på knappe 4 timar, så vel med bil som med tog eller buss. Kommunesenteret Vågåmo er ein konsentrert og triveleg handelsstad, med eit godt utbygd servicetilbod. Vågå kommune har ca. 3.550 innbyggjarar, eit godt barnehage- og skuletilbod, og eit allsidig og rikt kulturliv.

Vi meiner at det er viktig med ein god balanse mellom jobb og fritid -- med ei passe mengde arbeidsoppgåver. Er du glad i friluftsliv kan du kople av i både skog og fjell: det finst gode jakt- og fiskemoglegheiter. Den rurale bygda har i tillegg fleire idrettsanlegg med idrettsarenaer, fotballbaner og idrettshall med klatrevegg, skiløypenettverk og alpinsenter, og byr også på meir urbane tilbod som kulturhus, kino og galleri.

title: Localization Specialist
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.


Your Mission 

We are looking for a Localization Specialist on a temporary contract basis, running until the end of the year (with the possibility of extension) for a localisation project: English to Norwegian.

The Localization Specialist plays a critical role in bridging the gap between our global product offerings and regional markets. This role ensures that our digital content, educational resources, and other materials are not just translated but truly localized to resonate with our audiences.

You will ensure that every e-learning module, knowledge base article, and content asset feels native to the user, maintaining high standards for accuracy, tone, and accessibility across all digital touchpoints.


Core Responsibilities 

  • Core Localization & Translation:

    • Execute high-quality translations and localizations for primary languages.

    • Localize diverse content types, including e-learning, Knowledge Base articles, and high-impact customer communications (emails, guides).

  • AI & Workflow Innovation

    • Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to increase efficiency in translation and content adaptation while maintaining a "human-in-the-loop" approach for quality.

    • Ensure that AI-assisted content reflects the Mercell brand voice and local procurement nuances.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Act as an active collaborator within the Delivery Department to align localization needs with the broader content strategy.

    • Manage content review cycles, coordinating with product teams to ensure accuracy, and proactively revising localized materials based on internal feedback and product updates.

  • Technical Content & Quality:

    • Ensure "in-platform" accuracy by creating mock tenders to capture correct labels and screenshots for educational materials.

    • Maintain accessibility standards by writing and auditing alternative texts for digital imagery.

  • Content Maintenance:

    • Continuously update localized assets to reflect product developments, ensuring a seamless and consistent experience across all digital touchpoints and user-facing materials


Required Qualifications  

  • Linguistic Excellence: Native-level or C2 proficiency in Norwegian, with a deep understanding of local business nuances.

  • Digital Literacy: High proficiency in navigating SaaS platforms and content management tools.

  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to grammar, tone, and technical accuracy in a high-tempo environment.

  • Communication & Cooperation: Strong ability to coordinate between Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Delivery teams

  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple localization streams and meet tight deadlines.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Previous experience in localization, translation, or content management within a SaaS or international business environment. Experience within public procurement or regulated sectors is considered advantageous, but not required.

 

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Temporary contract basis (40hrs/week) until 31 December 2026 (with the possibility of extension)

Workplace type: Remote

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 23 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.


Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!


-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.
