title: Procurement Development Manager
description:
Do you thrive in transformation environments and have the leadership capability to take procurement to the next level? We are looking for a Procurement Development Manager who will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of procurement within a leading international energy company.

About the Role

As Procurement Development Manager, you will own and deliver the Procurement Development roadmap, leading a multi-year transformation agenda across our global organization. You will work closely with senior leaders and business stakeholders to establish world-class procurement practices, strengthen organizational capabilities, and ensure procurement is recognized as a strategic business partner.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a global procurement transformation journey in a company that is actively contributing to the energy transition and helping build a more sustainable future. You will be responsible for driving procurement excellence across processes, governance, digitalization, capability building, ESG, and supplier management while influencing stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and business functions.

The position can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Baar or Cressier depending on preferred location.

Key responsibilities

    Standardize and continuously improve Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes and governance across the organization.
    Design and implement best-practice procurement policies, frameworks, and playbooks that can be applied across countries, legal entities, and categories.
    Develop and maintain procurement tools strategy, including solutions such as eSourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, supplier portals, and analytics platforms.
    Establish common procurement data standards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting structures to enable global transparency and comparability.
    Drive change management and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working across Procurement, Finance, Operations, and the wider business.
    Lead and inspire a highly diverse and international team, creating a culture of growth, collaboration, courage, and continuous improvement.

We offer

At VAROPreem, you will join a welcoming and collaborative workplace where trust, personal responsibility, and professional development are highly valued. As the energy sector undergoes its most significant transformation in decades, you will have the opportunity to contribute to both today's energy needs and tomorrow's more sustainable solutions.

We offer a high degree of autonomy and encourage employees to take initiative, challenge established ways of working, and help shape the future of our business.

About you

You are a strategic and transformational leader who thrives on challenging the status quo and translating vision into tangible business results. You combine deep procurement expertise with strong commercial acumen, a data-driven mindset, and exceptional relationship-building skills.

You are confident influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex environments, while remaining pragmatic, collaborative, and focused on bringing people along the transformation journey. With your leadership experience and ability to inspire others, you create engagement, build high-performing teams, and drive sustainable change across international organizations.

Requirements

We believe you bring:

    Extensive experience within procurement, procurement development, organizational development, transformation, or functional excellence.
    Proven success leading large-scale, multi-year transformation programs across international organizations.
    Strong Source-to-Pay (S2P) expertise with practical experience in process design, optimization, and implementation.
    Excellent change management and stakeholder engagement skills.
    Experience working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
    A commercial mindset and the ability to identify opportunities that create business value.
    Experience from energy, oil & gas, refining, chemicals, manufacturing, infrastructure or other regulated and asset- intensive industries is highly desirable.
    Experience implementing or optimizing procurement technology platforms and digital procurement solutions.
    Fluent in English
    French and Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.

Next steps

We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but no later than 28 October 2026. Applying is easy – simply submit your CV or link your LinkedIn profile and answer a few screening questions. If you choose to apply with your LinkedIn profile and progress in the process, you will be asked to provide a CV at a later stage.

To ensure an objective and fair selection process, we use assessment tests as part of our recruitment process. As we apply continuous selection, the role may be filled before the application deadline.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact Hiring manager Camilla Dimberg, camilla.dimberg@varopreem.se or Recruitment Partner Jennie Lundqvist, jennie.lundqvist@varopreem.se.

As VAROPreem operates within critical infrastructure, a background screening as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted prior to any employment offer. During the interview process, candidates must be able to present a valid form of identification, such as a passport or national identity card, alternatively a population registration certificate together with a valid driving licence.

As parts of VAROPreem’s operations are subject to security-sensitive regulations, a security clearance, including a background check through official registers, may be required depending on the position. Any such security screening will be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Swedish Security Protection Act.

The union contact person can be found here.

Welcome with your application!

title: Software Engineer - (Media SRE)
description:
Meet the Team

The Collaboration Technology Group is redefining the future of teamwork, building services that connect people effortlessly across devices, locations and time zones.

Our team in Stockholm builds, runs, and continuously improves the core media platform services behind Cisco’s collaboration products, operating at global scale across numerous datacentres. We’re a passionate, collaborative team focused on real-time media reliability, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in our Stockholm Webex Media (WxMedia) & SRE organization, you will bring new real-time media features to life and drive resolution for high-impact media platform escalations. You will combine Site Reliability Engineering practices with real-time media streaming architectures and modern agentic AI (reusable Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM tooling) to transform how we monitor, diagnose, and auto-remediate global media services handling billions of audio and video minutes.

What You'll Do

    Media Escalations & Real-Time Reliability: Lead deep-dive troubleshooting for complex WxMedia platform issues, investigating packet loss, jitter, latency, audio/video degradation, and SIP/WebRTC signaling failures across hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments.
    Real-Time Media Delivery: Bring new real-time media features to life based on product requirements, ensuring high performance, scalability, and seamless global routing.
    Technical Design & Architecture: Design and implement high-resilience software systems for AI-assisted observability, automated incident response, and self-healing cloud media infrastructure.
    Agentic Workflows & Tooling: Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI agents, MCP tool integrations, and deterministic evaluation pipelines for automated operational decision support.
    Telemetry & Insights: Implement ingestion and correlation pipelines across distributed logs, metrics, OpenTelemetry traces, change events, and runbooks to accelerate Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) and Resolution (MTTR).
    Safe Production Automation: Develop proactive anomaly detection and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) remediation workflows with meticulous safety, security, and quality guardrails.
    Reliability & Scalability Engineering: Partner with application and infrastructure teams to define SLIs/SLOs, handle error budgets, and lead investigation post-incident reviews (PIRs).
    Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, establish engineering standards, and drive operational excellence across global development and operations teams.
    Cross-Team Delivery: Manage priorities and timelines, communicate progress clearly, and work across teams to turn production needs into reliable software and AI-assisted capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree + 8years of related experience, Master’s + 6 years, or PhD + 3 years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
    Consistent record as a Senior / Lead SRE or Software Engineer delivering distributed, high-availability SaaS or media platforms at scale.
    Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real-time applications (e.g., RTP/RTCP, SRTP, WebRTC, SIP, SDP, RTSP, or HLS/DASH).
    Strong proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or Java with experience designing microservices, APIs, and production automation.
    Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration in large-scale multi-cluster environments.
    Experience in SRE practices: SLI/SLO design, observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces), incident management, and automated root cause analysis (RCA).

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
    Experience with close-to-real-time systems and performance-sensitive code paths.
    Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
    Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.
    Experience building LLM pipelines, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
    Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ThousandEyes, or distributed tracing systems.
    Expertise in Terraform/IaC and GitOps/CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
    Experience implementing responsible AI guardrails, deterministic fallback logic, and policy-driven remediation engines.
    Experience with streaming and data platforms (Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/Vector DBs).
    Collabhiring

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Marksäkerhetsingenjör - Esrange Space Center
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular. With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

Would you like to help develop a workplace where people, technology, and space come together? At SSC Space, you will have the opportunity to contribute to something that truly makes a difference – Help Earth Benefit from Space.

We are now looking for a Ground Safety Engineer who shares our values – Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage – and wants to play an important role in our continued growth and development within space technology and launch operations.

REQUIREMENTS

Do you want a job where safety and space truly come together? As a Ground Safety Engineer in our Launch Team, you will play a key role in making our rocket and balloon launch campaigns possible.

In this position, you will work closely with the operational team and have a clear purpose: to ensure a safe and secure environment during our campaigns. Your responsibilities will span the entire process - from planning and preparation to being present during launch operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Planning, assessing risks, and preparing ground safety activities ahead of campaigns.
    Participating operationally during rocket and balloon launch campaigns.
    Maintaining and further developing the systems and equipment used during launch operations.
    Contributing to the continuous improvement of safety routines and working practices.

At SSC Space, you will receive comprehensive onboarding and training to enable you to take responsibility for ground safety during our campaigns. This is a unique opportunity to combine technology, safety, and hands-on work in an environment unlike any other in the world.

The role also involves operational work on-site during rocket and balloon campaigns, requiring flexibility in both working methods and working hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

To succeed in this role, we believe you are someone who thrives in a dynamic environment. You are flexible, solution-oriented, and comfortable quickly shifting your focus when circumstances require it. You have a strong technical interest and a safety mindset that comes naturally to you.

We would like you to have:

    A degree in Engineering or equivalent experience within a relevant technical field.
    Experience in safety-related work, risk assessments, or working in environments where safety is a key priority.
    A good understanding of safe working practices and operational procedures.
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
    The ability to work flexible hours during campaign periods.

Most importantly, we value your attitude and your willingness to contribute to a safe and successful team environment.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Convenient staff transportation between Kiruna and Esrange Space Center at a subsidized cost, making commuting easier for employees based in the Kiruna area.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

LOCATION

This is a full-time position based at Esrange Space Center outside Kiruna, where you will work at the heart of our operations. The role is primarily site-based, although remote work may be possible in exceptional circumstances. title: Systemtekniker / IAM-specialist till enheten Teknikplattform
description:
Välkommen till kommunledningskontoret. Här jobbar du tillsammans med medarbetare på avdelningar för kommunikation, hr, it, ekonomi, upphandling och fastighet samt avdelningarna kvalitet och planering, trygghet och hållbarhet samt kansli. På kommunledningskontoret ligger även organisationerna för näringsliv och destination samt gemensam service. Kommunledningskontoret är länken mellan våra förtroendevaldas beslut och kommunens alla verksamheter. Vårt uppdrag är bland annat att samordna och driva övergripande frågor inom demokrati, samhälls- och näringslivsutveckling samt ekologisk och social hållbarhet.

Mer information om hur det är att arbeta i Uppsala kommun hittar du på https://www.uppsala.se/jobb/

1 plats(er).


Vill du arbeta med identitet och åtkomst i en stor och komplex IT-miljö där säker och tillförlitlig digitalisering gör konkret nytta för både verksamhet och invånare? Hos oss får du arbeta med ett område som är centralt för en säker, effektiv och användarvänlig digital verksamhet. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där vi tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar lösningar som ska fungera för många olika verksamheter, system och användargrupper. Låter detta intressant? Välkommen med din ansökan!

Kommunledningskontorets it-avdelning är en central avdelning som har helhetsansvar för hela Uppsala kommuns it-miljö. Vi arbetar strategiskt, styrande och stödjande och vi finns nära verksamheterna och bidrar till att tidigt identifiera it-relaterade behov.

Till enheten Teknikplattform söker vi nu en till kollega. Enheten består av sexton personer och har i uppgift att tillhandahålla och utveckla en gemensam teknisk plattform. Vi ansvarar för hjärtat i kommunens it-leveranser som bland annat innefattar inloggning, behörighet, integration och andra gemensamma plattformstjänster.

Beskrivning av arbetsuppgifter

I den här rollen består arbetsuppgifterna huvudsakligen av följande:

    Konfigurering och felsökning i vår it-miljö.
    Federationsuppsättningar i Microsoft Entra ID och Nexus Digital Access Component.
    Arbete med Active Directory (AD).
    Arbete med Identity provider/Service provider (IDP/SP).
    Arbete med identitetslivscykel och automatiserad provisionering för kommunens användare och system.
    Arbete med autentisering, auktorisering och Single Sign-On (SSO).
    Arbete med Microsoft 365 inklusive Azure och tjänster.
    Omsätta verksamhetens behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.
    Medverka vid projektinförande.
    Dokumentera lösningar och tekniska vägval.
    Följa utvecklingen inom IAM och bidra till att våra tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt utvecklas över tid.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har högskoleutbildning inom it eller annan relevant utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet i närtid som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten.

Till den här rollen är det ett krav att du har:

    Erfarenhet inom federationsuppsättningar.
    Erfarenhet inom it-infrastrukturområdet, med fokus på IDP/SP (Identity provider/Service provider), identitets- och behörighetshantering (IAM) samt säkerhetslösningar.
    Erfarenhet av villkorsstyrd åtkomst (Conditional Access, CA) och hantering av privilegierad åtkomst (Privileged Access, PA).
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
    Goda kunskaper inom Microsoft Entra ID och Active Directory (AD).
    Goda kunskaper inom multifaktorautentisering (MFA) och Single Sign-On (SSO).
    Grundläggande kunskap för hur inloggning fungerar på enheter och i tjänster.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete i Nexus Digital Access Component eller motsvarande system.
    Erfarenhet av arbete med automatisering och skriptning.
    Kunskap inom protokoll: SAML, OIDC, OAuth och SCIM.
    Kunskap inom databas och utveckling av applikationer.

Som person är du utåtriktad i yrkesmässiga sammanhang och har lätt för att skapa och underhålla goda relationer. Du samarbetar väl med andra genom att vara lyhörd, kommunicera tydligt och hantera olika situationer på ett konstruktivt sätt. I din roll tar du initiativ och sätter i gång aktiviteter som ger goda resultat. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade omständigheter och ser möjligheter i förändringar. Vidare planerar, organiserar och prioriterar du ditt arbete effektivt samt sätter upp och håller tidsramar.

Upplysningar

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta: Oliver Milivojevic, enhetschef, 018-726 15 14.

Fackliga företrädare:
DIK, Erik Boman, 018-727 18 99.
Vision, Liselotte Ehn, 018-727 49 49.

Har du frågor gällande registrering av din ansökan, kontakta område rekrytering: 018-727 12 86.

I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du också kunna styrka att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

title: Personalansvarig Housekeeping Stockholm
description:

Du vet vad som krävs för att skapa kvalitet, leda medarbetare och få ett hotell att fungera – även när tempot är som högst. Nu har du möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet på ett nytt sätt.

Hos RA Hospitality får du fortsätta arbeta nära hotellbranschen, men i en roll där du utvecklar både människor och affärer. Här bygger du långsiktiga kundrelationer, leder våra konsulter och hjälper några av Sveriges främsta hotell att lyckas.

Om RA Hospitality

Om rollen

Du leder den dagliga driften, utvecklar kundrelationer och säkerställer hög kvalitet i våra leveranser.

Rollen kombinerar ledarskap, affärsutveckling och operativ problemlösning. Du arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning, schemaläggning, kvalitetsuppföljning, kundmöten och coachning av våra konsulter. Tillsammans med två kollegor ansvarar du för avdelningens utveckling, kvalitet och lönsamhet.

Vi tror att du

    

har erfarenhet som Chefshusfru, Hotellchef, Platschef eller liknande ledarroll

    

drivs av att utveckla människor och skapa goda kundrelationer

    

har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt och god ekonomisk förståelse

    

är van att planera, prioritera och fatta beslut i ett högt tempo

    

har kunskap inom personalledning och arbetsrätt

    

kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

    

har B-körkort

Därför ska du välja RA Hospitality

Hos oss får du fortsätta arbeta i hotellbranschen – men med möjlighet att påverka fler verksamheter och utvecklas i en affärsnära ledarroll.

Vi erbjuder bland annat:

    

stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar

    

ett engagerat team med hög energi

    

ett modernt kontor mitt i Stockholm med gym, restaurang, café och takterrass i huset

    

generösa personalförmåner och kompetensutveckling

    

ett av branschens starkaste nätverk inom hotell och besöksnäring

Vill du fortsätta utveckla hotellbranschen – från ett nytt perspektiv? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

title: Accountant
description:
Borealis is now Borouge International. Essential Materials, advancing the world.

Do you enjoy working with accounting in a role where accuracy, collaboration and continuous improvement go hand in hand? We are looking for an Accountant to join our Finance team in Stenungsund on a temporary contract covering a parental leave until June 30, 2028.

As part of our local Finance team, you will contribute to delivering efficient and compliant financial processes for our Swedish operations. The role offers a broad range of responsibilities and close collaboration with colleagues across the business as well as our Global Business Services (BSC).

You will work with daily accounting activities, reconciliations and reporting, while also playing an important role in the follow-up of payroll-related costs and employee benefits.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a structured way, taking ownership of their responsibilities and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Join us and Make Accounting Real!

What you will do

    Support reporting towards authorities and the follow-up of employee-related costs
    Manage travel and expense accounting and support related processes
    Collaborate closely with our Global Business Services team and act as a local contact for selected accounting processes
    Contribute to month-end and year-end closing activities within your areas of responsibility



About you

We believe you have a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field, preferably from a Higher Vocational Education programme (Swedish YH), combined with a genuine interest in accounting. With a good understanding of reconciliations and financial processes, you enjoy working with details while understanding how your work supports the business.

Further, you are structured and dependable in your way of working and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across functions and locations.

Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP, is considered an advantage. As you will interact with both local and international colleagues, professional proficiency in Swedish and English is required.



Our offer

Borealis has competitive compensation and benefits which you can read more about on our Career Page.

For this role in Stenungsund we also offer:

    Bonus
    Working time reduction
    Generous parental leave top-up
    Wellness allowance
    Borealis Employee Foundation, offering subsidized rentals of mountain cabins in Sweden and holiday apartments in Spain

Application Process

If you're excited about the prospect of joining our team and being a part of Making It Real, please submit your application via the “apply now” button in the job posting to apply directly.

If you have any questions, please contact Malin Westman, malin.westman@borealisgroup.com

Please note: We review applications on an ongoing basis and will get back to you as soon as the screening process has been completed



At Borealis, we are committed to an equal recruitment process. We value diversity, and all applicants & employees are treated fairly and equally. title: People & Production Manager - Material & Delivery
description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Material & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application

This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-17.  Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

title: Data Scientist - Commercial
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging data to drive commercial success in the gaming industry. In this role, you’ll focus on using analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimise game monetization strategies, support business development initiatives, and build scalable commercial tooling. You’ll partner with game designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to unlock data-driven insights that fuel our business growth and maximize player engagement.

Example of responsibilities

    

Analyse game performance metrics and player data to identify business opportunities.

    

Provide insights and recommendations to optimise in-game economies, pricing models, and player engagement initiatives.

    

Collaborate with business development and product teams to develop data-driven monetization strategies.

    

Design, build, and maintain commercial tooling to empower commercial teams.

    

Build dashboards and reports to track business performance and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

    

Utilize AI-assisted coding workflows to accelerate development.

We would love if you have

    

A creative and curious mind

    

Strong background in SQL

    

Experience in working with ETLs and data pipelines

    

Proficiency in Python for data modelling, analysis over large datasets, and script/tool building

    

Experience building tooling or interactive dashboards

    

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

    

Ability to communicate insights and strategies to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    

Experience or interest in games

    

Professional English communication skills.

This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Embedded Engineer - 20015
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An Embedded Engineer is needed for a product-focused engineering assignment involving system and software development. The role spans the embedded development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and concept development through system integration, software implementation, testing, troubleshooting and verification. The work is closely connected to the product and combines rapid prototyping with the delivery of robust, production-ready solutions.

Projects vary in size and technical scope, with multiple initiatives potentially running in parallel. The assignment involves short development cycles, investigation of technical issues, adaptation of existing systems, and maturing early concepts and prototypes into implemented solutions.

Key Responsibilities

    Contribute to embedded system and software development throughout the development lifecycle.
    Translate requirements and early concepts into implementable embedded solutions.
    Develop, adapt and integrate embedded software and system functionality.
    Support system integration activities across vehicle functions, electronics and embedded platforms.
    Perform hands-on testing, troubleshooting, analysis and verification of embedded systems.
    Use test rigs and representative test environments to validate functionality when required.
    Investigate existing systems and contribute to technical improvements and product adaptations.
    Collaborate closely with engineers from multiple technical disciplines in a fast-paced product development environment.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Embedded software and system development experience.
    CAN communication experience.
    System integration involving electronics, vehicle functions or complex embedded platforms.
    Embedded testing, verification and troubleshooting.
    Experience working with vehicle architecture is advantageous.
    Diagnostics experience is beneficial.
    Experience with electrification is considered an advantage.
    Familiarity with established automotive development processes and engineering systems is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience

A master's degree in mechatronics, physics, computer science, or another relevant technical discipline is required. Candidates should have practical experience in embedded software development and/or embedded system development, along with exposure to vehicle functions, electronics or system integration. The ideal consultant brings a hands-on engineering approach, enjoys investigating technical problems, and is comfortable working across a broad range of embedded technologies. Automotive industry experience, including complex vehicle architectures and established engineering processes, is advantageous.

title: Senior BCBS239 Expert
description:

Act as a Subject Matter Expert for BCBS239 regulatory requirements and industry best practises.

Build strong relationships and interact confidently with senior management and key decision-makers.

    

Support preparation of materials for Steering Committees, management forums, and regulatory discussions.

    

Contribute to the development of implementation roadmaps, recommendations, and remediation plans.

    

Design and deliver training sessions to increase organizational understanding of BCBS 239 in collaboration with the Swedbank RDARR competence center.

    

Provide expert guidance throughout implementation and compliance activities for Program Lead and other members.

Deep expertise in BCBS 239 and Risk Data Aggregation and Risk Reporting requirements

    

Proven experience supporting organizations in meeting regulatory expectations and supervisory requirements

    

Experience working in large-scale regulatory transformation programs

    

Experience working with regulators such as the European Central Bank (ECB) and/or Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (SFSA/Finansinspektionen).

    

Strong experience facilitating workshops and driving regulatory discussions.

    

Demonstrated ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders.

title: Food Business Leader
description:
Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

With our desirable and sustainable offer, Food is an essential part of the IKEA experience and our Swedish heritage. It is a strong reason for customers to visit, stay longer, and return more often. Food is often also a starting point to connect with the IKEA Brand. It shall always be convenient for customers to enjoy our accessible food offer in different store formats and at every meeting point – always with a focus on families with children.

This role is positioned in Commercial team within the Food RA structure, reporting to the Commercial Manager. You will lead the business by setting the preconditions for successful consumer and customer meetings. You drive growth by maximizing the commercial positioning, performance, and business opportunities of both the existing range and the new products and solutions under development.

Our team is based in Älmhult. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  

We are looking to hire 4 colleagues.

Job Description

As a Food Business Leader, you will be responsible for the end-to-end commercial business result and commercial direction of the assigned business and range scope, including global, regional and market-specific range. You will own the commercial content and priority of the Range Matrix, lead the commercial relationship with assigned anchor markets and bring one ranked commercial agenda into portfolio governance. Together with the Product Developer and Product Sourcing Leader, you will contribute to early joint direction setting by connecting customer and market needs with product possibilities and supplier capabilities.

On a typical working day, you will:

    Be responsible for the commercial business result for the assigned scope, including growth, profitability, affordability, positioning, relevance and range performance.  
    Be responsible for the commercial content and priorities, based on customer, retail, market, competitor and performance insights.  
    Define the customer proposition for the scope, including occasion, emotional value, price perception and desired customer response.  
    Act as main speaking partner for assigned reference markets and primary commercial contact for the scope across all markets, including relevant Market Operations Forums.  
    Bring one prioritized commercial agenda into portfolio governance, aligned with the Range Direction and supported by fact-based business cases.  
    Set the early direction and co-create the business brief with the Product Developer and Product Sourcing Leader, defining what the business needs and why.  
    Represent the full commercial teamat agreed development milestones, decision gates and performance reviews.  
    Responsible for pricing, improves and running range, including reference sales price, affordability, customer value and required profitability.  
    Responsible for commercial decisions, business cases and investment priorities for certifications and voluntary standards. Quality and Compliance own verification and legal compliance.  
    Monitor business and range performance, act on deviations and align Retail and development partners on corrective actions.

Qualifications

The role as a Food Business Leader requires you to have:

    High knowledge of the IKEA Vision, Business Idea, Culture and Values, with a good understanding of the IKEA business model, strategic landscape and ways of working.
    Deep knowledge of the assigned Food business and range scope, including customer needs, market differences, competitors, commercial performance, growth opportunities and range/product development.
    High knowledge of commercial business leadership and how data, insights, business cases and scenario analysis support decisions across the value chain.
    Strong business and commercial leadership, with the ability to take accountability for results, set priorities, make trade-offs and translate insights into clear commercial direction and business cases.
    Strong ability to understand the total business picture, connect strategic direction with tactical and operational priorities, and draw systematic conclusions from performance, financial and market data.
    Strong ability to lead, influence and build trust across a complex matrix, align stakeholders around common outcomes, communicate direction clearly and navigate ambiguity and change without formal authority.
    Passion of creating profitable growth, affordability and a relevant offer for the many people, taking end-to-end ownership from insight to results.
    Motivation by building strong relationships and working across countries, cultures, functions and organisational boundaries towards common business outcomes.
    Curiousity about changes in society, customer behaviour, markets and competitors, and motivated by challenging existing solutions and leading in a changing environment.

Additional information

We welcome your application!

We look forward to receiving your application by 18th of October at the latest. Apply by submitting your CV - please note that we do not ask for a cover letter in this recruitment process. Instead, you will have the opportunity to tell us more about you and your experience through the screening questions in the application system.  

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we might start interviewing early.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Bence Denes.

- Für ein renommiertes Haus im Gesundheitswesen in der Region Worb suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH.

### Was Sie über die Stelle in Worb wissen sollten

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gesundheitswesen

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

Worb liegt im Emmental im Kanton Bern und überzeugt durch seine attraktive Lage zwischen Stadt und Natur. Sie profitieren von einer guten Verkehrsanbindung mit regelmäßigen Bahnverbindungen nach Bern und Luzern sowie ausgezeichneten Straßenanbindungen. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein ausgewogenes Verhältnis von wirtschaftlicher Dynamik, erschwinglichen Lebenshaltungskosten und hoher Lebensqualität, was Worb zu einem zunehmend beliebten Arbeitsort macht.

### Ihre Verantwortung als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Worb

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Überwachung der Vitalzeichen und frühes Erkennen von Veränderungen

- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das bringen Sie zwingend mit

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

- Zwingend für diese Stelle: Einige Jahre Berufserfahrung

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Ihre neue Wirkungsstätte

Sie arbeiten in einer etablierten Institution im Gesundheitswesen – mit einem eingespielten Team, klaren Abläufen und echter Wertschätzung. Wichtig für diese Stelle: Einige Jahre Berufserfahrung. Dabei erwartet Sie ein Umfeld, in dem Fachlichkeit und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Worb verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, planen die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplom-Pflegefachfrauen und -männer in der Region Worb ist äußerst dynamisch und zeigt eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Fachkräften. Ihre Chancen auf eine Anstellung mit flexiblem Pensum sind ausgezeichnet, da Pflegeinstitutionen gezielt nach erfahrenem Personal suchen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie dabei, schnell und unkompliziert die passende Stelle zu finden und vermittelt Sie direkt an renommierte Arbeitgeber in Ihrer Region, wodurch der Einstieg deutlich erleichtert wird.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Worb

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – Ihre Karriere bekommt Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Worb

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Neerach liegt in der Zürcher Unterland-Region und besticht durch seine ländliche, dennoch gut erschlossene Lage. Sie erreichen den Ort bequem über die Kantonsstraßen und profitieren von einer guten Zuganbindung zu den regionalen Zentren. Als Arbeitsort ist Neerach attraktiv, weil Sie hier eine entspannte Atmosphäre mit kurzen Wegen verbinden können und trotzdem schnell in größere Wirtschaftszentren gelangen.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Neerach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege Demenz

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Neerach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Neerach verzeichnet eine steigende Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen im Demenzbereich, da die alternde Bevölkerung spezialisierte Langzeitpflege verstärkt benötigt. Als erfahrener Personalvermittler bietet Ihnen iPersonal einen direkten Zugang zu geeigneten Arbeitgebern in Ihrer Region und unterstützt Sie mit einer individuellen Stellenplatzierung, die Ihren beruflichen Anforderungen und persönlichen Bedürfnissen entspricht. Sie profitieren von unserer Expertise bei der Vermittlung von Fachkräften im Gesundheitswesen und erhalten dadurch einen deutlich vereinfachten Einstieg in ein erfüllendes Tätigkeitsfeld mit guten Perspektiven.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Neerach

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Neerach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

**Mission**

Au sein de l'équipe de la Maintenance, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements de production afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur fiabilité et leur performance. Vous participez à l'ensemble des activités du service maintenance tout en apportant une expertise particulière en électricité industrielle et en diagnostic de pannes.

**Vos principales responsabilités**

* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements de production.
* Diagnostiquer et dépanner les pannes électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et électromécaniques.
* Assurer la remise en service des équipements dans le respect des exigences sécurité, qualité et production.
* Participer à la mise à jour de la documentation technique et des schémas électriques.
* Identifier les composants défectueux ou obsolètes et rechercher des solutions de remplacement adaptées.
* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et accompagner les prestataires externes lors de leurs interventions.
* Participer aux actions d'amélioration continue visant à améliorer la fiabilité des équipements et à réduire les temps d'arrêt.
* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions dans la GMAO.


**Votre profil**

* CFC d'Automaticien ou formation technique équivalente avec expérience en maintenance industrielle.
* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (ISO 13485 ou équivalent).
* Expérience du dépannage et de la maintenance sur des équipements industriels variés, y compris des équipements anciens.
* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit.
* Solides connaissances en électricité industrielle et bonnes connaissances en mécanique industrielle et pneumatique.
* Connaissance d'une GMAO.
* Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques et du diagnostic de pannes.
* Connaissances en automates industriels et interfaces opérateur constituant un atout.
* Autorisation OIBT art. 13 ou 15 constituant un atout.
* Personne autonome et pragmatique, dotée d’un fort esprit de terrain et d’une approche orientée vers la recherche de solutions concrètes.


**Ce que nous vous offrons**

* Un environnement industriel de haute précision, technologiquement exigeant et stimulant.
* Une forte proximité avec la production, l’ingénierie et les clients.
* Une équipe engagée et collaborative.
* Des projets variés et des interactions avec des clients et équipes internationales.
* L’opportunité de contribuer concrètement à l’amélioration et à la transformation de nos processus qualité.
* Des possibilités de développement professionnel au sein d’un groupe international en croissance.


Chez Resonetics, nous valorisons l’excellence, l’engagement et l’esprit d’équipe. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets innovants dans un environnement dynamique, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

title: Risk Manager / Safety Officer  80-100%
description:
Risk Manager / Safety Officer (m/f/d) 80\-100%  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
Safety requires people who take responsibility.  
At Eawag, people from a variety of disciplines work together to find solutions to one of the key challenges of our time: the protection and sustainable use of water as a resource. To ensure that research, laboratory work, technical installations and day\-to\-day operations run safely and reliably, a professional and forward\-looking safety and risk culture is required. For this challenging and varied role, we are looking for a committed individual to join us as soon as possible as a  
Risk Manager / Safety Officer (m/f/d) 80\-100%  
In this key role, you will play an active part in shaping and further developing Eawag's safety and risk management, and ensure that risks are identified, assessed and effectively managed at an early stage. In this role, you will combine strategic risk management with operational safety responsibilities and work closely with the Directorate, line managers as well as specialist and safety managers.  
Risk management (40\-50%)  
You will coordinate and further develop the institutional risk management system and the associated processes, methods and tools, and ensure their implementation.  
You will advise the Directorate and risk owners on strategic and methodological issues and prepare the basis for decision\-making for the relevant committees.  
You will coordinate the annual risk management process and assist the relevant research and support departments in identifying, assessing and managing risks.  
You will be responsible for the maintenance and quality assurance of the risk catalogue, as well as monitoring risk mitigation measures.  
You will coordinate and author the annual risk reporting for the Directorate and the ETH Board.  
You will be the contact person for risk management audits and reviews, and will coordinate the necessary documentation and position statements.  
You will further develop information, training and awareness\-raising measures and represent Eawag on relevant specialist committees within the ETH Domain.  
Operational safety (40\-50%)  
You will take operational responsibility for safety coordination at the Dübendorf (ZH) and Kastanienbaum (LU) sites and advise the Directorate on safety measures, protection objectives and safety concepts.  
You will coordinate the further development and quality assurance of safety guidelines and requirements\-based training for laboratory, field and experimental work.  
As part of your responsibilities, you will be responsible for general occupational health and safety, risk assessments, planning measures and monitoring safety\-related requirements.  
You will implement safety\-related measures within your area of responsibility and consult external experts where necessary.  
You will coordinate and monitor emergency planning and drills, support the internal crisis management team in the event of an incident, and ensure deputy leadership for the crisis management team.  
You will be part of the occupational health management team or the relevant steering committee and will coordinate the links between occupational health and safety, and occupational health management.  
You will coordinate and accompany audits, inspections and regulatory site visits, and maintain close cooperation with regulatory bodies, specialist departments and external safety partners.  
You will represent Eawag on safety committees and working groups within the ETH Domain.  
Your profile  
Several years' professional experience in risk, safety or quality management, ideally in a complex research, academic or technical environment.  
A university degree or equivalent qualification, ideally in a field related to risk management, safety, natural sciences, engineering or a related discipline.  
In\-depth knowledge of risk management, ideally in accordance with ISO 31000, as well as a good understanding of health and safety issues.  
Training as an ASGS specialist or ASGS expert  
Extensive experience in advising senior managers and coordinating cross\-functional processes, projects and teams.  
A structured, independent and solution\-oriented approach to work, as well as the ability to communicate complex issues clearly.  
Clear communication in German, another national language and English, as well as a confident and courteous manner when dealing with a range of different contacts.  
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  
Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it \- we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about Eawag as well as our conditions of employment.  
The closing date for applications is 15 October 2026\. If necessary, the vacancy will remain open until the post is filled. Please submit the following documents with your application: CV, letter of motivation, relevant employment references, and relevant diplomas and qualifications.  
If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to email , Deputy Director.

As the fastest-growing global sportswear brand, reaching millions of runners worldwide, On is building an authentic community through direct fan interaction - across major sporting expos, run crews, cultural moments, brand events, and grassroots retail activations. We are looking for a Global Director of Brand Events to elevate our global event ecosystem, shaping the brand activation strategy, enabling tools and frameworks for scale, and developing innovative formats and partnerships across key markets. We are looking for someone with a strong entrepreneurial spirit who takes ownership, brings new ideas forward, and thrives in building and evolving a global function. The Brand Events team plays a critical role in bringing our community together and translating On’s mission into meaningful, memorable experiences around the world.

Your Mission

- Set the global strategic vision for brand activations and events at On
- Develop immersive event formats aligned with global campaigns and Go-To-Market initiatives
- Identify and implement tools and technologies to elevate event experiences and enable scale
- Source, negotiate, and manage partnerships with relevant organizations to drive event impact and success
- Promote and amplify the full range of On’s brand activations across channels and markets
- Define global event brand standards and ensure consistent execution across all touchpoints
- Analyze event performance and data to drive continuous improvement and learning
- Enable and support markets to execute events in line with global brand guidelines
- Lead the development of communication frameworks across pre-, during-, and post-event moments
- Grow and strengthen On’s global community and fan base through impactful activations
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global team of brand activation and event experts

Your story

- 10+ years of experience leading and delivering global events, with a proven track record of impactful brand activations
- 7+ years of experience managing and developing high-performing teams
- Ideally, experience within a global sportswear, athletic, or performance brand, with a strong understanding of community-driven marketing
- Experience working in a creative agency environment (in-house or external), with a strong creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Deep expertise across physical, digital, and hybrid event formats at global scale
- Strong leadership skills, with experience operating in highly matrixed, international organizations
- Entrepreneurial, proactive, and driven to innovate, optimize, and build new approaches
- Excellent communicator with an inspiring, collaborative, and positive leadership style

Your Team

Your team shapes and delivers On’s global brand events—from campaign launches and athlete moments to community activations and key brand experiences. They ensure every event reflects our brand, supports our strategic priorities, and creates meaningful connections with our community.

The team is structured across four core global streams: Event Strategy & Concept Development, Event Management, Event Operations, and Event Communications, and works in close partnership with our regional event teams to ensure strong and consistent execution worldwide.

title: Digital Marketing Manager (100%)
description:
Are you a digitally savvy marketing professional who combines strategic thinking, strong analytical capabilities, and execution excellence? Are you passionate about creating seamless digital client journeys, optimizing user experiences, leveraging data and AI, and driving measurable commercial outcomes?

Vontobel Asset Management is seeking a highly motivated Digital Marketing Manager to join the Client Content Center and help shape the future of our digital marketing capabilities.

This role reports directly to the Head of Digital Marketing & Content. The successful candidate will play a critical role in enhancing digital client experiences, optimizing digital touchpoints, and delivering measurable business impact through data-driven marketing.

The role sits at the intersection of digital marketing, client experience, analytics, content generation, and business growth. A key focus will be connecting digital marketing activities to commercial objectives, fundraising priorities, client engagement, and business outcomes through robust performance measurement and continuous optimization.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a candidate who brings:

Proven experience developing and optimizing digital client journeys across websites, campaigns, email, and other digital touchpoints.

Strong expertise in digital marketing, UX optimization, website management, conversion optimization, and client engagement.

Excellent data literacy and a deep understanding of digital marketing KPIs, analytics, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.

Demonstrated ability to turn data and client insights into actionable recommendations that drive commercial impact.

Experience establishing and managing dashboards that measure engagement, lead generation, conversion, client journeys, and business outcomes.

Strong understanding of marketing technologies, CRM platforms, automation tools, and digital analytics solutions.

Passion for Artificial Intelligence, automation, personalization, and emerging technologies.

Experience leveraging AI to improve client engagement, digital experiences, scalability, operational efficiency, and marketing effectiveness.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across marketing, distribution, investments, product management, technology, and compliance.

A growth mindset, strong curiosity, and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

Key responsibilities



Digital client journeys & client experience

Design, manage, and continuously optimize digital client journeys across the full client lifecycle.

Enhance client engagement, conversion, and retention through personalization and journey optimization.

Ensure digital experiences support commercial priorities, fundraising objectives, and client needs.

User experience & digital platforms

Drive continuous improvements of website usability, navigation, accessibility, and conversion performance.

Conduct user research, behavioral analysis, and testing to identify optimization opportunities.

Implement best practices in UX and digital experience management across client-facing platforms.

Digital analytics & KPI leadership

Develop and maintain KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting that measure digital performance and business impact.

Monitor and optimize key digital KPIs including engagement, leads, conversions, traffic quality, and client journey effectiveness.

Generate insights and recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and contribute to commercial growth.

AI, automation & innovation

Identify and implement AI-driven solutions that enhance digital marketing performance and client experiences.

Drive the adoption of marketing automation, personalization, predictive analytics, and new digital capabilities.

Promote innovation and continuous experimentation across the digital marketing ecosystem.

Digital campaign activation

Support the execution and optimization of integrated digital campaigns across all relevant channels with relevant stakeholders

Maximize performance across website, email, social media, paid media, and marketing automation platforms.

Partner with marketing teams to increase effectiveness and reach.





Candidate Profile

University degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

5+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital experience management, performance marketing, or related fields.

Experience within asset management, financial services, banking, or another regulated industry preferred.

Strong expertise in digital analytics platforms, web analytics, CRM systems, website management, and marketing automation technologies.

Demonstrated success in developing KPI frameworks and using data to drive decision-making and optimization.

Strong understanding of digital client journeys, UX principles, customer behavior, and conversion optimization.

Experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools and modern digital technologies.

Experience working with cross-functional teams in an international environment.



Personal profile

Highly client-centric and digitally minded.

Strong analytical thinker with exceptional data literacy skills.

Commercially focused with a clear understanding of growth drivers and business outcomes.

Passionate about AI, technology, innovation, and digital transformation.

Collaborative and influential with strong stakeholder management capabilities.

Curious, proactive, and continuously seeking opportunities to improve performance.

Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Hands-on, results-oriented, and focused on measurable impact.



Location Requirement



This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.



What do we offer?

Experienced, diverse team in an international environment

Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive



We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.



At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.



We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Birr liegt im malerischen Freiamt des Kantons Aargau und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage in einer hügeligen Landschaft. Die Region verfügt über gute Verkehrsanbindungen mit direktem Zugang zu Bahn- und Busverbindungen, die Sie schnell ins Limmattal oder nach Zürich bringen. Als Arbeitsort ist Birr attraktiv, da Sie hier eine hohe Lebensqualität mit guten Schulen, Naherholungsmöglichkeiten und einem starken Gemeinschaftsgefühl verbinden können, während die Nähe zu wirtschaftlichen Zentren Ihre beruflichen Perspektiven sichert.

### Ihr Wirkungsfeld als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Erwachsenenpsychiatrie in Birr

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Damit überzeugen Sie uns

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Erwachsenenpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Erwachsenenpsychiatrie in Birr verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

In der Region Birr herrscht eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Erwachsenenpsychiatrie, da Fachkräfte auf diesem Niveau vielen Einrichtungen fehlen. Sie profitieren als Diplom-Fachperson von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können zudem flexible Pensenmodelle von 80–100% nutzen, um Ihre Work-Life-Balance optimal zu gestalten. iPersonal unterstützt Sie dabei, schnell und zielgerichtet die richtige Stelle zu finden, da wir etablierte Kontakte zu lokalen Arbeitgebern haben und Ihnen umfassende Beratung während des gesamten Vermittlungsprozesses bieten.

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.
