Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================







Zurich is a leading multi\-line insurer that serves its customers in global and local markets. With about 55,000 employees, it provides a wide range of property and casualty, life insurance products and services in more than 215 countries and territories. Zurich's customers include individuals, small businesses, and mid\-sized and large companies, as well as multinational corporations.



Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================





Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?



In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine\-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI\-augmented enterprise.



We're looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future\-ready, cost\-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves \- in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.



You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.



We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.



If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.



Find out why Zurich Switzerland is among the "Top 3" companies in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security.







**What you will do**



* Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey
* Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event\-driven and AI\-augmented workflows
* Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust
* Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI\-augmented workflows \- ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer
* Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes






**What you bring**



* 7\+ years in software or security engineering \- ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry \- with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands\-on Keycloak experience
* Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent\-to\-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI\-augmented development (Copilot, , agentic workflows)
* Solid understanding of fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud\-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)
* Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade\-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written, is a plus






**Your contact**



Talent Acquisition Consultant: ( )



  



**Additional Information**



Full time or part time: 80 \- 100%



Work location:



Hybrid work: up to 40%







We look forward to receiving your online application \- even without a cover letter.



You are welcome to convince us of your motivation in a personal meeting.







**Who we are**



Zurich is a strong brand \- more than 1\.4 million Swiss customers place their trust in our products and services. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, helping our customers in 210 countries and territories to understand and protect themselves from risk. title: Installateur/trice sanitaire à Martigny (H/F/D)
description:
Description de l’entreprise

Ici, le travail parle avant tout le reste. Les chantiers valaisans ont leurs exigences, leurs rythmes, leurs équipes qui se connaissent et une culture du travail bien fait qui ne se raconte pas, elle se vit.

Nous sommes une agence de placement active dans toute la Suisse (28 agences), mais c'est ici, en Valais, que nous cherchons quelqu'un d'ancré. Quelqu'un qui connaît les entreprises locales, leurs façons de travailler, et qui n'a pas besoin d'apprivoiser la région avant d'être efficace.

Pour l'un de nos partenaires établis en Valais, nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e installateur·trice sanitaire.

Description du poste

Du neuf comme de la rénovation, de la planification jusqu'à la mise en service vous couvrez l'ensemble du cycle d'une installation sanitaire.

Planification & organisation

- Étudier les plans d'architecte ou de bureau technique, définir les besoins et calculer les dimensions
- Évaluer les quantités de matériaux, fixer les délais et établir les plans de montage
- Organiser l'approvisionnement, le transport et l'entreposage du matériel sur chantier

Pose de conduites

- Préfabriquer et poser les réseaux d'alimentation eau et gaz, ainsi que les conduits d'évacuation des eaux usées
- Couper, raccorder, souder et fixer les canalisations dans murs, sols et plafonds
- Raccorder l'installation au réseau public, procéder aux essais d'étanchéité et consigner les résultats
- Isoler les conduites contre le bruit, la condensation et l'incendie
- Mettre en service, contrôler et régler la pression

Montage & installation

- Installer lavabos, douches, baignoires, WC, chauffe-eau, adoucisseurs et robinetteries
- Poser des installations solaires thermiques ou photovoltaïques et des systèmes de ventilation
- Assurer le contrôle final et rédiger les rapports de chantier

Entretien & dépannage

- Localiser et réparer les fuites, déboucher, détartrer, remplacer joints, filtres et appareils défectueux
- Intervenir rapidement chez les clients dans le cadre de contrats d'entretien
- Assurer la maintenance des outils et des machines, trier et éliminer les déchets selon les normes en vigueur

Profil recherché

- CFC d'installateur/trice sanitaire
- Expérience solide sur des chantiers en Suisse, idéalement en Valais
- À l'aise aussi bien sur du neuf que sur de la rénovation et du dépannage
- Capable de lire des plans techniques et de travailler en autonomie
- Disponible et réactif — le secteur ne prévient pas toujours avant de tomber en panne
- Bon esprit d'équipe : vous coordonnez régulièrement avec maçons, chauffagistes, carreleurs et électriciens

Nous offrons

Les entreprises avec lesquelles nous travaillons en Valais ont bonne réputation, et ce n'est pas un hasard. Vous intégrez un environnement où le métier est respecté et où votre expérience a de la valeur dès le premier jour.

- Poste fixe avec un salaire à la hauteur de votre expertise
- Perspectives réelles d'évolution et de formation continue
- Un réseau d'entreprises partenaires solides dans la région
- Et bien sûr, vous travaillez là où vous vivez

ASTRIA est un nouveau concept premium dédié au **mieux\-vieillir, au bien\-être et à l’accompagnement global de la personne**.

 

Pour accompagner l’ouverture et le développement d’ASTRIA à Genève, nous recherchons des personnalités professionnelles, élégantes et passionnées, capables d’allier **expertise esthétique, qualité de service et véritable sens commercial**.Nous recherchons une personne passionnée par l’univers de la beauté, du bien\-être et des nouvelles technologies, qui apprécie autant la relation humaine que la dimension commerciale du métier.

Vous aimez comprendre les besoins d’une cliente, l’accompagner dans ses objectifs et lui proposer un parcours personnalisé adapté à ses attentes.

**Accueil \& expérience client**

**Consultation \& conseil**

* Participer aux consultations personnalisées
* Identifier les besoins, attentes et objectifs de chaque cliente
* Présenter les différentes solutions et technologies proposées par ASTRIA
* Construire et recommander des parcours personnalisés

* Répondre aux questions et accompagner la cliente dans sa prise de décision

* Assurer un niveau d’excellence constant dans l’exécution des prestations
* Respecter strictement les protocoles d’hygiène, de sécurité et de confidentialité


 

**Développement commercial**

 

* Développer et fidéliser votre portefeuille de clientes

Description de l'entreprise

**Location:** Geneva, Lausanne, or Zurich (Hybrid)


**The Company**

A Swiss\-headquartered, FINMA\-regulated securities firm at the forefront of digital asset trading and financial services. The company provides institutional\-grade infrastructure covering custody, tokenization, trading, staking, and derivatives for banks, corporates, hedge funds, family offices, and blockchain foundations.

With \~100 employees and a rapidly growing international footprint, the company is expanding its Swiss sales team.

Description du poste
--------------------

**The Role**

As Institutional Sales Associate, you will play a key role in prospecting, qualifying leads, and supporting the full sales cycle. This is a client\-facing position with significant exposure to senior team members and institutional clients.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct targeted research to identify high\-potential prospects (institutions, corporates, hedge funds, family offices, blockchain foundations, issuers)
* Initiate outbound outreach via email, calls, and social channels to qualify leads within the Swiss market
* Own all phases of the sales cycle: prepare tailored presentations, proposals, and client\-facing materials
* Schedule and coordinate client meetings; manage follow\-ups and pipeline communication
* Develop deep product knowledge across the full suite (custody, tokenization, trading, staking, derivatives)
* Maintain accurate CRM records (Salesforce) and support reporting/forecasting
* Foster ongoing client relationships; identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities
* Stay informed on crypto industry trends, competitors, and regulatory developments
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Marketing, Legal, and Operations teams
* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to the sales process

Profil recherché
-----------------

**Your Profile**

* 2\-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or client\-facing roles within financial services, fintech, or digital assets
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or related field
* Strong understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the digital asset ecosystem
* Excellent communication skills; ability to simplify complex technical concepts
* Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce) to track pipeline and client interactions
* High attention to detail; ability to manage multiple prospects and prioritize effectively
* Fluent in English; French or German is a strong advantage
* Professional, responsive, customer\-centric mindset

**Important:** This role involves significant cold outreach \- they're building from scratch. Candidates must have existing contacts in banks/institutions with crypto interest. Pure advisory or market analyst profiles without direct sales experience are not a fit.


**The Offer**

* Base salary \+ performance\-based variable
* Hybrid work model with flexibility
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and institutional clients

* Für die Weiterbildung der dir zugeteilten Assistenzpsychologinnen und Assistenzpsychologen sowie Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzte übernimmst du direkte Verantwortung und stellst deren fachliche Begleitung durch regelmässige Supervision sicher.

Angela Brucher

Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden stellen wir an unseren neun Unternehmensstandorten gut zugängliche, persönliche und wirkungsvolle psychiatrische Behandlungen und die Betreuung von erwachsenen Menschen in den Kantonen und Appenzell Ausserrhoden sowie im Fürstentum Liechtenstein sicher.

**Online bewerben**  


Wir sind digital unterwegs und setzen uns für Nachhaltigkeit ein, daher freuen wir uns auf deine Online\-Bewerbung über unsere Homepage.

Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingegangen ist, bekommst du eine Empfangsbestätigung per E\-Mail zugestellt. **Vorstellungsgespräch mit HR und Fachbereich**

**Preboarding**  


Zwischen der Annahme der Stelle und dem ersten Arbeitstag können Sie als neue Mitarbeiterin oder neuer Mitarbeiter bereits auf relevante interne Informationen zugreifen. So können Sie sich ein differenziertes Bild des Unternehmens machen und sich bereits auf den Job vorbereiten.


**Erster Arbeitstag**

Head of Information Systems
===========================

Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------

Our client, an international company active in physical petroleum products trading and shipping, is looking for its Head of Information Systems for its Geneva office.

Description du poste
--------------------

Reporting to the General Manager, you define and deliver the information systems strategy supporting the full trade lifecycle, from front to back. You are the key point of contact for all information systems matters in Geneva and a trusted business partner to senior management.


**Your responsibilities**

Information systems strategy and governance

* Define, maintain and execute the information systems roadmap, aligned with the business objectives of the Geneva office and the group
* Establish governance, policies and procedures, and prioritise the project portfolio with business stakeholders
* Prepare, manage and monitor the capital and operating budgets for information technology


Trading platform ownership

* Act as owner of the energy trading and risk management platform: implementation, evolution, upgrades and integration with market data, accounting and reporting systems
* Translate business requirements from Trading, Operations, Risk, Middle Office, Finance and Accounting into functional specifications
* Coordinate configuration, user acceptance testing and go\-live, and ensure data quality and system stability


Infrastructure and operations

* Oversee the Microsoft environment (Active Directory, Microsoft 365, servers, network, end\-user devices) with the team and external providers
* Ensure high availability, backup, business continuity and disaster recovery of all critical systems
* Supervise user support in line with agreed service levels


Team leadership

* Lead, coach and develop a small information technology team
* Set objectives and priorities, and balance the workload across the team


Security and compliance

* Define and enforce security policies, access management and user awareness, in coordination with group information technology
* Identify and mitigate technology risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory, audit and data protection requirements


Vendor management

* Select, negotiate with and manage software vendors, integrators and service providers, including market data vendors
* Monitor contracts, licences, service levels and costs

Profil recherché
-----------------

* Degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, finance or a related field
* At least 10 years of experience in information technology, including 5 years in a leadership role, within an oil or petroleum products trading company
* Proven track record of at least one end\-to\-end implementation of an energy trading and risk management system; hands\-on experience with Nova is a strong asset
* Solid business understanding of physical oil trading: deal capture, vessel and cargo scheduling, nominations, inventory, demurrage, positions, profit and loss, mark\-to\-market, settlement and invoicing
* Good knowledge of Microsoft\-based infrastructure, application integration, information security and compliance in a trading environment
* Experience managing vendors and technology roadmaps; knowledge of artificial intelligence use cases and governance is a plus
* A hands\-on leader, able to drive strategy while staying close to operations and to the team
* Fluent English is mandatory; French is a strong plus

Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================







Zurich is a leading multi\-line insurer that serves its customers in global and local markets. With about 55,000 employees, it provides a wide range of property and casualty, life insurance products and services in more than 215 countries and territories. Zurich's customers include individuals, small businesses, and mid\-sized and large companies, as well as multinational corporations.



Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security (m/f/d) 80\-100%
=================================================================





Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?



In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine\-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI\-augmented enterprise.



We're looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future\-ready, cost\-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves \- in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.



You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.



We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.



If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.



Find out why Zurich Switzerland is among the "Top 3" companies in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as Senior Platform Engineer \- Identity \& Security.







**What you will do**



* Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey
* Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event\-driven and AI\-augmented workflows
* Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust
* Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI\-augmented workflows \- ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer
* Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes






**What you bring**



* 7\+ years in software or security engineering \- ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry \- with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands\-on Keycloak experience
* Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent\-to\-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI\-augmented development (Copilot, , agentic workflows)
* Solid understanding of fine\-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud\-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)
* Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade\-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written, is a plus

We value and defend what is right and promote opportunities for equity among our professionals, regardless of gender, disability, LGBTQ \+, race, ethnicity, generations, belief, etc. Our talent acquisition and hiring processes respect this commitment daily. Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------


**Client:**

Our client is an established Swiss financial institution with an international client base and activities spanning Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Treasury. ---------------------------

**Client:**

Description de l'entreprise
---------------------------

For one of our clients based in the **Canton of Geneva**, we are offering a position as:


Coal Purchase Manager
---------------------


For a **fixed\-term** contract with a **100% workload.**

Description du poste
--------------------

**Sourcing \& Supplier Management**

* Identify and engage international coal suppliers in line with operational and commercial requirements.
* Review and assess supplier proposals based on quality, pricing, and overall value considerations.
* Manage and develop the supplier portfolio, including qualification, compliance checks, and ongoing performance monitoring.

* Effective communicator, comfortable working in cross\-functional and multicultural environments, with willingness to travel internationally.

An established international service\-based organization is seeking an experienced **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** to lead the finance operations of its European regional business. The organization operates globally, bringing together professionals, industry leaders, regulators, and stakeholders to advance innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional excellence in highly regulated sectors.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic and hands\-on finance leader to serve as a key member of the regional leadership team while partnering closely with global finance and European regional operations. The successful candidate will oversee all accounting, treasury, financial planning, and financial analysis activities across the European region and play an integral role in supporting organizational growth and operational excellence.

Only candidates currently residing within commuting distance of Basel, Switzerland will be considered for this role.

**Position Summary**

Supporting regional and global leadership, the **Manager, Accounting \& Finance** will be responsible for the financial stewardship of the European region. This role combines strategic financial planning with operational accounting leadership and requires a strong understanding of cross\-border business operations, international accounting standards, treasury management, and regulatory \& tax compliance.

The successful candidate will provide financial insight, business partnership, and operational leadership to support both regional and global objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Serve as the primary finance partner to regional leadership.
* Provide recommendations regarding financial performance, risk management, and long\-term business sustainability.
* Support regional strategy development through financial modeling, business case analysis, and evaluation of new opportunities.
* Participate actively as a member of the European regional leadership team.


**Accounting \& Financial Operations**

* Lead and manage all regional accounting activities, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements and internal policies.
* Oversee general ledger activities, month\-end and year\-end close processes, and financial reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of management reports and financial analyses.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to maintain consistency in accounting and reporting practices.


**Treasury, Accounts Receivable \& Accounts Payable**

* Manage banking relationships and regional cash management activities.
* Oversee accounts receivable and accounts payable functions.
* Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements.
* Support treasury planning and financial risk management activities across the region.


**Budgeting, Forecasting \& Financial Analysis**

* Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing forecasting activities.
* Develop monthly financial forecasts and cash flow projections.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and develop corrective action plans in collaboration with regional leaders.
* Prepare ad\-hoc and insightful profitability, cost\-benefit, and break\-even analyses to support strategic decision\-making.


**Compliance, Audit \& Risk Management**

* Maintain compliance with relevant accounting, tax, VAT, and regulatory requirements throughout as it pertains to the organization’s operations.
* Monitor changes in financial and tax legislation and implement necessary process updates.
* Support annual external audits and coordinate with auditors as required.
* Review contracts alongside local leadership and external legal advisors to minimize risk exposure and ensure compliance.

* Manage relationships with external legal counsel, tax advisors, banking institutions, and other statutory authorities.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and oversight to two (2\) finance staff and internal operational team members as applicable.


**Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, controls, and operational efficiencies.
* Participate in global initiatives to enhance financial systems, planning processes, and reporting tools.
* Drive continuous improvement across finance operations.


**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

title: Admissions Lead
description:
### About Us \& Our Community

At International School Rheintal (ISR), we are proud to combine world-class educational standards with a "small and mighty" community feel. As a fully accredited International Baccalaureate (IB) World School - serving around 220 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12 in our award-winning, ecologically designed campus in Buchs SG - we deliver a globally recognised curriculum that empowers students to thrive anywhere in the world.

We believe our strengths lie in our scale: high relational trust, deep connectedness between faculty and students, and an environment where every individual is known and valued. At ISR, our team is intrinsically motivated, highly professional, and dedicated to stepping up for one another. Being a close-knit campus means we work right at the centre of the action. It also means we value flexible, solution-focused colleagues who see stepping outside a formal job description not as a chore, but as a rich, hands-on way to contribute to an outstanding international learning environment and to understand how a vibrant learning community functions.

* Workload: 50% (Adjustable to 60% for the right candidate based on administrative scope)
* Location: International School Rheintal, Werdenbergstrasse 17, 9470 Buchs, Switzerland
* Start Date: December 2026 (or by arrangement for the right candidate)
* Closing date for applications: 25.10.2026
* Preliminary interviews: 30.10.26 and 4.11.26
* Full Job Description

### About the Role \& The Day-to-Day

Choosing the right school - whether relocating from abroad or seeking an internationally focused education right here in the Rheintal - is one of the biggest decisions a family will ever make. As our Admissions Lead, you are often the very first voice and face of ISR, shaping that critical first impression with empathy, composure, and authentic warmth. We are looking for a knowledgeable, supportive guide who understands how to make a great impression, answer complex questions, find information quickly, and support families thoughtfully through their decision-making process.

Alongside admissions, you will serve as an essential operational anchor for our campus: handling day-to-day inquiries, answering phones, providing executive support to school leadership, and stepping in to organise key operational tasks to keep the school running smoothly. We will provide thorough onboarding and ongoing support as you learn our community and systems.

This role offers a base workload of 50% (approx. 21 hours per week), which could be expanded up to 60% depending on the candidate's skills and agreed administrative responsibilities.

While the contract includes statutory Swiss vacation allowance (5 weeks per year), we off er an annualised hours model. This allows you to work increased hours during active school term weeks and busy admissions windows in order to enjoy additional time off during school holiday periods (exact scheduling agreed individually with the right candidate).

### What "Doing a Great Job" Looks Like

* You serve as a memorable, welcoming ambassador for ISR - ensuring every prospective family (both local and international), guest, and visitor experiences authentic warmth, professionalism, and care from their very first interaction.
* Prospective parents feel genuinely supported, well-informed, and reassured from their first inquiry through arrival. You guide local and relocating families with authenticity, deep school knowledge, and an attentive, solution-focused attitude.
* You provide reliable, calm, and proactive executive support - managing daily phone calls, handling front-of-house inquiries, organising operational details, and keeping office routines running efficiently.
* You collect and verify necessary documentation (school reports, references, authority requirements) from international and local institutions cleanly and confidentially, enabling informed admissions decisions that serve our students, the family, and the school.
* You collaborate effectively with pedagogical staff to support new student transition into the school.
* You maintain up-to-date inquiry and enrollment data, supporting school leadership in having reliable forecasts and early visibility into incoming student numbers across all grade levels.

### What You'll Bring

* A natural ability to connect with people from both local and diverse international backgrounds - helping all prospective families feel instantly welcome, listened to, and cared for.
* High emotional intelligence, a genuinely collaborative spirit, and an appreciation for the Rheintal region; you thrive in a close-knit team where colleagues support one another, communicate openly, and share a common dedication to our school's mission.
* High organisational competence, comfort handling phone communications, and the initiative to step in and support school leadership or organise logistics when needed.
* The ability to move smoothly between high-focus administrative work (reports, data entry, executive support) and warm, face-to-face interactions when visitors or phone calls change your workflow.
* Digital confidence and a proven track record of mastering new technology platforms, with a readiness to learn our school management systems.
* Proven experience in customer-facing roles, administration, hospitality, or public relations. We value exceptional interpersonal and organisational skills above specific education sector experience, although you bring excitement about working in a school. Strong communication skills in English (our language of instruction). Our ideal candidate is also confident in at least conversational German to connect with local families and our local community.
* Valid authorisation to work in Switzerland and residence within commuting distance to Buchs SG.
* Willingness to undergo background checks for working with children.

Ready to be the welcoming heart of our school? If you bring authentic warmth, sharp organisational instincts, and a passion for helping families find their place at ISR, we would love to hear from you.

### How to Apply

Please submit your application by completing our [application form](https://www.isr.ch/userfiles/isrmvc/Documents/Jobs/ISR-Job-Application-Form-2021-V3_2-%20%281%29.doc) and uploading it on our [job portal](https://app.jobportal.abaservices.ch/job-overview/37d31658-511e-4577-ae2e-6c927f14266e).

*Data Protection Note: By submitting your application, you consent to International School Rheintal processing your personal data strictly for recruitment purposes in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG).*

title: Deputy Program Manager - Cell 4
description:
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Program Manager (ARP) to join Cell 4.
Reporting to the Program Manager, the Deputy Program Manager plays a key role in steering MSF’s operations within Cell 4, contributing to operational decision-making and ensuring the relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance. The role supports operational planning, resource mobilisation, programme monitoring, security and advocacy, while supervising and supporting Heads of Mission. As a central operational role within MSF, the Deputy Program Manager acts as a key interface between missions and headquarters, ensuring effective information flow, coherent HQ support and a shared understanding of operational priorities across OCG. The role also contributes to the internal visibility of programmes and to critical reflection on operational challenges and MSF’s social mission.

Tasks & Responsibilities
By delegation of responsibilities and tasks from the Program Manager:
In accordance with the Charter, the Chantilly / La Mancha agreements and OCG operational policy, the Deputy Program Manager ensures the overall relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance to populations in danger within a selected group of countries.
Is responsible for steering the operations planning cycle, ensuring that transversal internal processes are respected, that MSF policies are translated into action unless otherwise justified, and that resources are adequately mobilized to support operational objectives and the chosen intervention strategies.
Ensures that key medical and/or humanitarian stakes are identified within each mission and project, prioritizes them, and carries them internally and externally through bilateral meetings, documentation, témoignage and communication; determines how MSF will address the issues at stake and defines its public position.
Creates and maintains a network of relevant political, humanitarian, medical and academic contacts to ensure the best possible knowledge of the environment for teams working in the field, especially in tense contexts.
Monitors the level of exposure to risk affecting teams in the field and validates the security framework proposed by the Heads of Mission for each project.
Supervises, advises, supports and evaluates the Heads of Mission in the fulfilment of their overall responsibilities and duties; in this perspective, provides them with all relevant information and visits missions at key moments (exploratory missions, programme definition phases and/or reorientations due to evolving needs, context or policy).
Organizes the best possible level of headquarters support to field operations by optimizing the input, expertise and control functions of professionals from different departments, each representing a technical field necessary for the effective running of projects in the field.
Monitors programme implementation and the effective running of missions by analysing situation and programme reports submitted by the coordination and providing feedback; is accountable for timely reporting on operations, including institutional donors supporting MSF’s action in the field.
Aims to continuously improve MSF’s medical assistance by evaluating results achieved, leading thematic working groups on intervention strategies, initiating critical reviews as needed, supporting operational research projects, and contributing to the design and delivery of training modules for coordinators.

Your profile
Education
University-level degree in international relations, social sciences, medicine, public health, a paramedical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience
Experience in humanitarian aid, ideally as an MSF Head of Mission or Emergency Coordinator. Previous experience as a Medical Coordinator is an asset.
Expertise in analysing and managing unstable contexts and crisis situations.
Experience in, and interest in, the medical, social, economic and political dimensions of countries affected by humanitarian crises, whether acute or protracted, or undergoing development, is an asset.

Languages
Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
Knowledge of a third language is an asset.

Skills/ professional competencies
Strong representation and diplomatic skills, with proven negotiation abilities.
Strong strategic planning and orientation skills.
Ability to analyse humanitarian contexts, with a sound understanding of medical issues and MSF intervention strategies.
Ability to design and plan medical programmes, build and maintain networks, motivate and lead teams, organise responsibilities and delegate tasks effectively.
Excellent writing skills.

Personal Abilities/Qualities
Dynamic and flexible, with strong initiative and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with a clear sense of priorities.
Highly developed stress-management skills.
Strong communication and public-speaking skills.
Participative management style.

Terms of employment :
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
3 years contract, renewable once.
Working place: Based in Geneva, with very frequent international travel.
Ideal start date: 1st of December 2026
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.

The application deadline is  31 of october 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.
